Natural leadership abilities, initiative and autonomy.

title: Technical Manager – Automation & Controls
description:
Hello, my name is Anthony Chacon, Recruitment Consultant at FED ManuTech, specializing in engineering, manufacturing and technical positions.

I am currently recruiting a Technical Manager in Automation & Controls for a manufacturing company specializing in the design and production of automated industrial equipment.

This is a key technical leadership position combining hands-on PLC programming, electrical control design oversight and team guidance. The successful candidate will act as the technical reference for the team, ensuring the quality, reliability and safety of industrial control systems.

Mission
Your Role

Provide technical leadership and oversee electrical control design and automation activities.

Develop and program PLC systems, including building control programs from scratch.

Review, challenge and validate electrical drawings, ensuring technical accuracy and compliance with safety requirements.

Oversee control panel designs, control circuits and machine wiring.

Support designers and project engineers with technical reviews and troubleshooting.

Maintain consistent programming and electrical control design standards across the team.

Participate in equipment testing, commissioning and troubleshooting activities.

Identify design issues and implement improvements to control systems and engineering processes.

Act as the technical point of contact and support knowledge transfer within the team.

Working Conditions

Salary up to $150,000 for an experienced engineering professional.

Experienced technical profiles may also be considered based on qualifications and expertise.

40-hour workweek, with Fridays ending at 1:00 p.m.

Five weeks of vacation, scheduled during the construction holiday period.

Medical, dental, life and long-term disability insurance.

Free parking.

Professional training and development opportunities.

Collaborative, low-hierarchy work environment.

Stable position with significant influence over technical decisions.

Your profile
Your Profile

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation & Controls or a related discipline.

Significant experience in industrial automation and machine control systems.

Strong hands-on PLC programming experience, including developing programs from scratch.

Excellent ability to read, review, challenge and validate electrical control drawings.

Solid knowledge of control panels, control circuits and industrial machine wiring.

Ability to identify design errors and safety concerns with confidence and minimal onboarding.

Previous experience providing technical guidance or managing a team.

Strong leadership, autonomy, analytical skills and technical judgment.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

A background as an industrial electrician or electromechanic before completing an engineering degree would be considered a strong asset.

If you have strong expertise in industrial automation and controls and are looking for a technical leadership role that allows you to remain involved in programming and engineering, I would be happy to discuss this opportunity with you.

Mission
Bonjour, je suis Camille, Conseillère recrutement au sein de Fed Finance, spécialisée dans l’accompagnement des cabinets comptables.

J'accompagne aujourd'hui un cabinet comptable situé à Joliette pour le recrutement d'un responsable de l'équipe de tenue de livre.

Rejoindre ce cabinet, c’est intégrer une équipe expérimentée et collaborative, qui cultive depuis plus de 50 ans son expertise en comptabilité et en fiscalité. Porté par une approche humaine, un réel esprit d’équipe et une volonté constante d’évoluer, le cabinet offre un environnement où chacun peut contribuer, apprendre et s’épanouir professionnellement.

Vos principales responsabilités :
- Superviser l'équipe de tenue de livres et assurer le suivi de ses activités au quotidien.

- Effectuer la révision des dossiers de tenue de livres et vérifier l'exactitude des informations comptables.
- Identifier les ajustements à apporter aux dossiers et accompagner les collaborateurs dans leur mise en application.

- Participer à la préparation et à la révision des feuillets fiscaux
- Préparer les dossiers de fin d'année financière et assurer leur transfert à l'équipe de certification pour la réalisation des missions d'avis au lecteur.
- Prendre en charge certains dossiers jusqu'à la préparation des provisions d'impôt.

- Formation en comptabilité ou en administration.
- Expérience significative en tenue de livres et en révision de dossiers comptables.
- Expérience en supervision ou en coordination d'équipe, idéalement dans un environnement de cabinet comptable ou de services d'impartition.

- Aptitudes en accompagnement, en formation et en développement des compétences.

Ce cabinet indépendant se distingue par son modèle de fonctionnement atypique, qui repose sur un réseau de professionnels incorporés travaillant en toute autonomie. Il accompagne une clientèle francophone composée principalement de PME privées issues de secteurs d'activité variés.

Ce qui le distingue ? Une véritable liberté entrepreneuriale !
Chaque collaborateur est libre de définir le volume horaire qu'il souhaite consacrer au cabinet, d'organiser son emploi du temps selon ses disponibilités et de conserver sa propre clientèle en parallèle.

Un modèle de collaboration pensé pour les CPA qui souhaitent conjuguer activité en cabinet, indépendance professionnelle et flexibilité au quotidien.

Aujourd'hui, le cabinet souhaite accueillir de nouveaux collaborateurs partageant cette vision du travail et désireux d'évoluer dans un environnement fondé sur la confiance et l'autonomie.

Vos principales responsabilités :

En tant que collaborateur(trice) indépendant(e), vous prendrez en charge vos mandats de manière autonome, de la planification jusqu'à leur livraison auprès des clients.

- Prendre en charge des mandats de compilation et d'examen auprès d'une clientèle de PME.
- Assurer la préparation et la réalisation complète des dossiers, conformément aux normes professionnelles en vigueur.
- Gérer vos mandats de A à Z, en veillant au respect des échéanciers et des standards de qualité.
- Entretenir une relation directe avec les clients et répondre à leurs besoins en matière de comptabilité.
- Identifier les particularités des dossiers et assurer les suivis nécessaires auprès des clients.

Les conditions de collaboration

Le cabinet propose un modèle de collaboration particulièrement flexible, pensé pour des professionnels qui souhaitent conserver leur indépendance et organiser leur activité selon leurs propres disponibilités.

- Liberté dans le volume horaire : vous choisissez le nombre d'heures que vous souhaitez consacrer aux mandats du cabinet et vous engagez sur les disponibilités annoncées.
- Flexibilité des horaires : vous organisez votre emploi du temps en fonction de vos contraintes personnelles et professionnelles.
- Indépendance professionnelle : vous avez la possibilité de conserver et de développer votre propre clientèle en parallèle de votre collaboration avec le cabinet.
- Autonomie dans les mandats : vous gérez vos dossiers et vos relations clients de manière indépendante, avec un accompagnement lors de votre intégration.

Votre profil
Le profil recherché :
- Posséder un statut de travailleur autonome incorporé (société constituée) afin de pouvoir intervenir en sous-traitance.
- Détenir obligatoirement le titre CPA, les profils sans titre pourront également être considérés selon leur expérience
- Justifier d'un minimum de 3 années d'expérience en cabinet comptable.
- Avoir une bonne connaissance des logiciels Caseware et Taxprep.
- Être parfaitement autonome dans la gestion de ses dossiers et de ses relations clients.
- Faire preuve de rigueur, de professionnalisme et d'un excellent sens de l'organisation.
- Apprécier un environnement de travail où la confiance et l'autonomie occupent une place centrale.

Poste : directeur principal, Planification financière et analyse (FP&A) et Partenariat d’affaires
Lieu de travail : Mirabel (Québec)
Salaire : 145 000 $ à 175 000 $
Type de poste : permanent, temps plein
Secteur d’activité : fabrication

L’offre

Notre client, une entreprise internationale bien établie dans le secteur de la fabrication, est à la recherche d’un directeur principal, planification financière et analyse (FP&A) et partenariat d’affaires pour diriger ses activités de planification financière, de prévision et de suivi de la performance d’entreprise.

Relevant directement du chef des finances, cette personne jouera un rôle stratégique clé pour stimuler la performance financière, améliorer la rentabilité et appuyer les décisions d’affaires. En étroite collaboration avec la haute direction, les équipes des ventes et des opérations, la personne retenue saura transformer les données financières et opérationnelles en informations d’affaires exploitables.

Il s’agit d’une excellente occasion de diriger et de développer davantage la fonction de planification financière et de prévision (FP&A) au sein d’un environnement de fabrication en pleine croissance comptant plusieurs sites.

Principales responsabilités :

- Diriger les processus de budgétisation annuelle, de prévision et de planification financière à long terme.
- Superviser la modélisation financière, l’analyse de scénarios et la production de rapports sur le rendement.
- Analyser les coûts de fabrication, les marges, la productivité et la rentabilité par produit, par client et par unité d’affaires.
- Collaborer avec les équipes des opérations et des ventes afin d’identifier les possibilités de réduction des coûts et d’améliorer la rentabilité.
- Surveiller les indicateurs de performance clés (IPK), analyser les écarts et recommander des mesures correctives.
- Appuyer les stratégies de tarification, les évaluations de rentabilité des contrats et la planification d’affaires.
- Renforcer les processus de rapports financiers, de prévisions et les outils de mesure de la performance d’entreprise.
- Diriger, encadrer et développer l’équipe de FP&A.
- Appuyer les initiatives stratégiques, les investissements et les activités potentielles de fusions et acquisitions.

Qualifications :

- Baccalauréat en finance, en comptabilité ou en administration des affaires.
- Le titre de CPA en cours d’obtention ou un MBA est considéré comme un atout.
- Plus de 10 ans d’expérience en FP&A, en finance opérationnelle ou en finance du secteur manufacturier.
- Plus de 5 ans d’expérience en leadership, y compris la gestion d’équipes et de gestionnaires.
- Solide expérience dans un environnement de fabrication multisite.
- Connaissances approfondies en matière de budgétisation, de prévision, de modélisation financière, de comptabilité analytique et d’analyse de rentabilité.
- Expérience dans le développement ou la transformation d’une fonction de FP&A.
- Connaissances avancées de SAP, de Power BI et des outils de compte rendu financier.

We operate or service corporate and affiliated dealer stores. With a distinctive product and service offering and complementary store formats ranging from neighbourhood hardware stores to big box stores, our RONA+, RONA and Dick’s Lumber banners are well equipped to help meet the needs of all DIYers and contractors.

You’ve got the talent? We’ve got the tools! Here, your work and ideas will contribute to building a flourishing organization. Your voice will always be heard and valued. You’ll find career opportunities that live up to your ambitions and be able to further develop your unique set of skills.

So, if you’re looking to do what you love, we could be a perfect match.

By joining the RONA family, you’ll enjoy many benefits, such as:

• An inclusive and safe working environment

• Promotion of work-life balance

• Exclusive employee discounts

• Benefits: insurance (certain conditions apply), annual salary review, etc.

• Access to the GreenShield+ telemedicine platform, including virtual consultations with healthcare professionals and pharmacy services

• Opportunities for advancement within the company

• An employer that’s involved in the community

• Teamwork and ongoing training

• A comprehensive training program for all new hires

• A student incentive program

• And much more!

Become a key member of the Rona team! Make a difference by ensuring that the backstore and returns are managed smoothly. Your attention to detail and efficiency will be essential to our success, and you'll contribute directly to an exceptional customer experience while building your career in a dynamic environment!

Your role:

• Receive all product deliveries and maintain flow of inventory on store shelves (sort and unpack product, operate forklift to transport product to appropriate areas)

• Schedule deliveries and shipments, authorize unscheduled deliveries, and ensure space is available for incoming products

• Ensure the accuracy and integrity of inventory received as well as related administrative documents

• Complete Return to Vendor (RTV) duties; communicate with vendors as necessary

• Work with other store teams with regards to merchandise movement and delivery inquiries and concerns

• Order parts for differents products

• Other related tasks to ensure the store runs smoothly

• Experience operating forklift/power equipment such as lifts, order pickers, and similar equipment

• Experience in a warehouse performing inventory handling and stocking

• Experience in a retail environment dealing with inventory handling and stocking

• Ability to lift up to 40 pounds daily without assistance

• Ability to understand and perform basic arithmetic (addition, subtraction)

• Ability to perform under difficult work conditions such as in extreme cold, heat, inclement weather, heights, or while being exposed to constant/intermittent sounds (if applicable)

If selected for an interview, please advise our Store team if you require accommodation during the interview and assessment process and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.

RONA is committed to encouraging diversity and inclusion. We are pleased to consider applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of race, colour, religion, sexual orientation, gender, nationality, age, disability, or any other protected status.

title: Microsoft Fabric Consultant
description:
Our client is embarking on a strategic data modernization initiative and is seeking a senior Microsoft Fabric consultant to help establish a modern enterprise data platform. This is a greenfield opportunity to design and implement the foundation that will centralize data from numerous internal and external sources, creating a scalable, reliable source of truth for the organization.

Working closely with technical and business stakeholders, you will lead the discovery, architecture, and implementation of a Microsoft Fabric solution capable of ingesting, transforming, and organizing large volumes of structured and semi-structured data.

## What You'll Be Doing

• Lead the design and implementation of a Microsoft Fabric data platform.

• Conduct discovery sessions with internal stakeholders to understand current data sources, architecture, and future reporting requirements.

• Design scalable ingestion pipelines for data from approximately 30 external partners and internal systems.

• Build processes to ingest, validate, and transform large XML datasets into structured, analytics-ready formats.

• Develop robust ETL/ELT pipelines using Microsoft Fabric Data Factory, Lakehouse, and related Fabric services.

• Design and implement a modern data model that consolidates information from multiple systems into a single source of truth.

• Integrate data from SQL Server-based data warehouses, third-party vendors, and additional external data sources.

• Create reliable processes for handling inconsistent or imperfect source data while maintaining data quality and integrity.

• Collaborate with business and technical teams to support future reporting, commission, and analytics initiatives.

Location: Downtown Vancouver, BC

Our client, a boutique investment management firm based in downtown Vancouver, manages alternative investment strategies across a diverse portfolio of private market investments and structured financial products. title: Sr. Accountant
description:
We are looking for an experienced Sr. Accountant with hands-on experience working in a shared services environment to join a pharmaceutical organization in Mississauga, Ontario on a contract basis. In this role, you will take ownership of key accounting activities, support accurate and timely financial reporting, and contribute to a disciplined month-end close process. You will serve as a key liaison between corporate finance, shared services, and local business teams, coordinating the resolution of accounting issues, strengthening collaboration, and identifying opportunities to improve processes and efficiency.

Responsibilities:
• Serve as a key liaison between corporate finance, shared services, and local business teams to address accounting inquiries, resolve issues, and ensure alignment on deliverables and reporting expectations.

• Investigate accounting discrepancies and processing issues, identify root causes, and coordinate corrective actions with the appropriate teams through to resolution.

• Lead core month-end accounting activities, including preparing and reviewing journal entries, reconciliations, and reporting packages for corporate finance.

• Manage the full close cycle for assigned entities, coordinating shared services inputs and ensuring deadlines are met and financial information is complete, accurate, and compliant with reporting requirements.

• Apply sound judgment to prioritize deliverables, take ownership of issue resolution, and escalate matters appropriately.

title: Construction Manager
description:
Our client is a well-established privately owned commercial general contractor based in the Fraser Valley with more than 25 years of experience in the construction industry.

The organization delivers a diverse range of projects throughout BC, including commercial buildings, industrial warehouses, tenant improvements, institutional projects, corporate roll-outs, and multi-family developments.

They are looking to add an experienced Pre Construction Lead to their team, with the primary focus on commercial construction.

This is an excellent opportunity for a leader who enjoys being involved from the early stages of a project through tender and award and wants to work closely with senior leadership, clients, consultants, subcontractors, and the project management team.

Key Responsibilities
• Lead the estimating process for commercial construction projects, from initial budgets through final tender and award.

• Review architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, civil drawings, specifications, and other tender documents.

• Manage multiple estimates and competing deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy.

title: Part-Time Merchandising Service Associate
description:
At RONA, our employees let their passion blossom every day. Our teams are driven by the desire to help people bring their projects to life and are committed to making a difference in the communities we serve.

We operate or service corporate and affiliated dealer stores. With a distinctive product and service offering and complementary store formats ranging from neighbourhood hardware stores to big box stores, our RONA+, RONA and Dick’s Lumber banners are well equipped to help meet the needs of all DIYers and contractors.

You’ve got the talent? We’ve got the tools! Here, your work and ideas will contribute to building a flourishing organization. Your voice will always be heard and valued. You’ll find career opportunities that live up to your ambitions and be able to further develop your unique set of skills.

So, if you’re looking to do what you love, we could be a perfect match.

By joining the RONA family, you’ll enjoy many benefits, such as:

• An inclusive and safe working environment

• Promotion of work-life balance

• Exclusive employee discounts

• Benefits: insurance (certain conditions apply), annual salary review, etc.

• Access to the GreenShield+ telemedicine platform, including virtual consultations with healthcare professionals and pharmacy services

• Opportunities for advancement within the company

• An employer that’s involved in the community

• Teamwork and ongoing training

• A comprehensive training program for all new hires

• A student incentive program

• And much more!

Become a key member of the Rona team! Make a difference by optimizing product presentation and ensuring compliance with visual standards. By putting your technical skills to good use, you'll benefit from ongoing training and stimulating challenges in a dynamic environment, while contributing directly to an exceptional customer experience and a well-organized store.

Your role:

• Assemble and dismantle displays according to seasonal changes, merchandise arrivals and stock levels

• Ensure that merchandise placed on displays complies with planograms and the company's visual presentation standards

• Ensure that available inventory above the bay is shelved, that all price tags are properly positioned, and that products are brought forward when needed

• Greet customers in a professional and friendly manner and refer them to a member of the in-store team if they need specific advice

• Ensure cleanliness and convenience, so that products are accessible and customers can move easily through the aisles

• Other related tasks to ensure the store runs smoothly

What we're looking for:

• Working knowledge of basic tools needed for the job, such as hand tools, drills, and saws (preferred)

• Ability to prioritize tasks

• Ability to move heavy objects using the appropriate equipment

• Experience in forklift driving (an asset)

• Ability to utilize web-based computer programs to accomplish assigned tasks

• Ability to understand and perform basic arithmetic (addition, subtraction)

• Available to work from 6 a.m. to 3 p.m., Monday to Friday

If selected for an interview, please advise our Store team if you require accommodation during the interview and assessment process and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.

RONA is committed to encouraging diversity and inclusion. We are pleased to consider applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of race, colour, religion, sexual orientation, gender, nationality, age, disability, or any other protected status.

description:
## Oracle Fusion GL Consultant

Location: Hybrid / Downtown Toronto.

Work Arrangement: 2 days onsite per week

Duration: 16-month contract

## Pay Rate: 55 - 70

Our client, a large and complex enterprise organization, is looking for an Interim Oracle Fusion GL Consultant to support an international finance transformation initiative. title: Risk Analyst III_CAN
description:
Nous recherchons un conseiller principal en risque de crédit pour se joindre à une équipe qui soutient l’analyse des contreparties et la gestion d’un portefeuille de risques à Montréal. Dans ce rôle de type Analyste d'affaires, la personne retenue contribuera aux décisions de crédit, à la surveillance continue des expositions et à l’amélioration des pratiques de gestion du risque en partenariat avec les équipes d’affaires. Il s’agit d’un role dans un mode de travail hybride nécessitant une présence au bureau au moins trois jours par semaine. Un excellent niveau d’anglais est important pour interagir avec les partenaires d’affaires, et le bilinguisme français-anglais constitue un atout.

Responsabilités:

• Évaluer les dossiers de nouvelles et de nouvelles contreparties existantes à partir d’analyses quantitatives et qualitatives afin de recommander des cotes de crédit, des limites, des modalités de paiement et des solutions adaptées au niveau de risque.

• Assurer la gestion quotidienne d’un portefeuille assigné en réalisant les revues de crédit, le suivi des demandes liées aux transactions potentielles, la vérification des disponibilités de limites et le traitement des demandes d’intégration et de levée de blocages.

• Travailler étroitement avec les unités d’affaires et groupes partenaires pour gérer les événements de crédit, notamment lors de l’intégration de contreparties, des retards de paiement, des défauts ou d’autres situations à risque.

• Examiner des transactions complexes avec les équipes commerciales et fonctions partenaires afin de structurer des protections de crédit appropriées et de définir des conditions contractuelles adéquates.

• Coordonner les échanges avec les assureurs-crédit, courtiers et partenaires internes tels que les équipes juridiques et financières pour mettre en place des mesures de mitigation comme des garanties, des modalités de paiement ou des déclencheurs contractuels.

• Surveiller quotidiennement le portefeuille à l’aide des outils, rapports et renseignements de marché disponibles, puis signaler rapidement toute détérioration du profil de risque ou tout événement défavorable.

• Produire, valider et présenter des rapports et analyses sur l’exposition, le vieillissement des comptes clients, les prévisions de ventes, les dépassements de limites et d’autres indicateurs utiles à la gouvernance du crédit.

• Veiller au respect des cadres de gouvernance et des contrôles de crédit en identifiant les écarts, en documentant les bris de limites et en soutenant la mise en conformité des processus de suivi.

• Contribuer à l’optimisation de la fonction risque de crédit en pilotant la standardisation, l’automatisation et l’amélioration continue des processus, incluant l’utilisation de systèmes de gestion du risque et d’outils analytiques.

• Appuyer les initiatives et projets liés aux systèmes de risque de crédit et à l’évolution des pratiques opérationnelles, lorsque requis, en collaboration avec les parties prenantes concernées.r

title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
Our client is a well-established and growing industrial manufacturing organization located in the Fraser Valley, with a long-standing reputation for designing and manufacturing specialized equipment and innovative solutions for a range of industries.

They are seeking an experienced Supply Chain Manager to lead and optimize the organization's end-to-end supply chain operations. This is a key leadership position responsible for ensuring materials, components, and finished goods are available when needed while balancing cost, quality, inventory levels, production requirements, and supplier performance.

Reporting to the Vice President of Operations & Engineering, this role will work closely with Operations, Engineering, Production, Production Control, Sales, and Finance.

## Key Responsibilities

Supply Chain Leadership

• Lead supply chain functions including planning, purchasing, inventory control, receiving, warehousing, and material logistics.

• Develop and execute supply chain strategies aligned with operational and corporate objectives.

• Establish departmental goals, priorities, KPIs, and performance measures.

• Lead, coach, mentor, and develop the supply chain team.

• Manage the annual supply chain budget.

Procurement & Supplier Management

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with strategic suppliers and external partners.

• Lead supplier negotiations and long-term sourcing strategies.

• Manage supplier capacity planning to support current and future production requirements.

• Monitor supplier performance, availability, pricing, quality, and delivery.

• Identify opportunities for cost reduction and improved supplier performance.

Inventory & Materials Management

• Optimize inventory levels while ensuring production has the materials required to meet customer commitments.

• Improve inventory accuracy, material flow, and warehouse utilization.

• Partner with Production and Operations to anticipate material requirements and address potential shortages.

• Improve processes surrounding purchasing, receiving, inventory, and internal material movement.

Risk Management & Continuous Improvement

• Develop and maintain supply chain risk-management strategies.

• Identify, assess, prioritize, and mitigate risks that could affect production continuity.

• Develop contingency and business continuity plans for key supply-chain risks.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on cost reduction, efficiency, inventory optimization, and operational excellence.

• Support trade compliance, contractual risk, and supplier governance initiatives.

description:

title: Property Manager
description:
Are you an experienced Property Manager with a background in both commercial and residential real estate? Do you enjoy overseeing property operations, building strong tenant relationships, and ensuring properties are maintained to a high standard?

Our client is seeking a versatile Property Manager to oversee a portfolio of commercial and residential properties. This opportunity is ideal for a hands-on professional who combines strong operational knowledge with financial acumen, excellent communication skills, and a proactive approach to property management.

Working closely with property owners, tenants, contractors, and internal stakeholders, you will help ensure properties operate efficiently, budgets are managed effectively, and tenant and owner expectations are consistently met.

• Support initiatives that improve operational efficiency and protect long-term asset value.

• Build and maintain positive relationships with residential and commercial tenants, property owners, and stakeholders.

• Respond to inquiries, resolve concerns, and manage disputes professionally.

• Coordinate tenant communications, notices, and follow-up on outstanding issues.

• Provide updates on property performance, maintenance, expenditures, and ongoing projects.

## Leasing & Contract Administration

• Support lease administration, renewals, documentation, and compliance with lease terms.

• Coordinate vendor agreements, obtain quotes, and monitor contractor performance.

• Maintain accurate property records, inspection reports, contracts, and management documentation.

• Identify opportunities to improve tenant satisfaction, property standards, and operational processes.

title: SAP Project Coordinator
description:
## Project Coordinator – SAP S/4HANA Deployment

Industry: Manufacturing

Location: GTA West, Ontario

Work Arrangement: 5 days onsite

Contract: 6 months

## Position Overview

The Project Coordinator will support the SAP Program Director and project management team by taking ownership of recurring administrative and coordination responsibilities. The successful candidate will ensure governance meetings are properly prepared, workstream updates are collected, project documentation is maintained, and incoming resources are onboarded efficiently.

This is a hands-on execution support role, not a strategic PMO or SAP technical delivery position.

## Key Responsibilities

## Project Administration & Resource Onboarding

• Coordinate onboarding of new project team members, consultants and external resources.

• Arrange project-related access, Teams channels, SharePoint folders, documentation repositories and distribution lists.

• Ensure incoming resources receive the information and access required to become productive quickly.

## Governance & Meeting Coordination

• Coordinate preparation for recurring project governance meetings.

• Prepare agendas, PowerPoint presentations, status reports and supporting materials.

• Contact workstream leads approximately 48 hours before meetings to request updated slides and project information.

• Consolidate workstream updates into executive-ready presentations.

• Schedule meetings, coordinate participants and distribute materials.

• Capture decisions, meeting minutes, actions, owners and deadlines.

• Follow up on outstanding items to ensure governance meetings result in timely actions and decisions.

## Workstream Coordination & Follow-Up

• Coordinate with leads across Testing, Data Migration, Integration, CSV, Training and Change Management.

• Request and consolidate updates on deliverables, milestones, risks and outstanding activities.

• Track action items and follow up with responsible stakeholders.

• Identify missing information or overdue submissions and escalate appropriately.

• Support communication between the Program Director, Project Manager, workstream leads and other project stakeholders.

## Project Reporting & Documentation

• Maintain action logs, meeting records, trackers and project documentation.

• Support preparation of Steering Committee and executive reporting materials.

• Assist with coordination activities associated with testing, data migration, cutover preparation and go-live readiness.

description:
Nous recherchons un DIRECTEUR DES FINANCES pour se joindre à une organisation au centre-ville de Montréal dans le cadre d’un contrat. Ce mandat d’une durée minimum de 4 mois, est en hybride 1 jour semaine en présentiel et 4 jours semaine en télétravail, et implique des interactions régulières avec des partenaires internationaux ainsi que des livrables mensuels à cadence serrée.

title: VP/Director of Finance
description:
## Controller (Bilingual)

Location: Downtown Ottawa | Free Parking

Industry: Not-for-Profit | Unionized Environment

Our client, a well-established national not-for-profit organization, is seeking a fully bilingual Controller to lead finance and administrative operations in a unionized environment. Reporting to senior leadership, this role supports an annual budget of approximately $41M and is responsible for financial stewardship, compliance, reporting, payroll oversight, and administrative leadership across national and regional offices.

This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on, collaborative finance leader who enjoys working in a mission-driven organization and can balance strategic insight with day-to-day operational execution.

Key Responsibilities

## Financial Management & Reporting

• Lead the preparation and coordination of the annual operating budget of approximately $41M.

• Oversee day-to-day accounting operations, including internal controls, cash flow, accounting policies, and investments.

• Prepare financial statements, management reports, budget-to-actual analyses, and other financial reporting for leadership.

• Monitor financial performance, investigate variances, and provide recommendations to senior leaders.

• Ensure compliance with all statutory and regulatory requirements, including CRA, payroll, and Statistics Canada filings.

• Act as the primary contact for internal and external audits and coordinate all related activities.

• Support contract review and negotiations for goods, services, and cost-saving opportunities.

• Provide financial guidance to internal stakeholders, vendors, financial institutions, and external partners.

• Maintain and monitor membership-related financial and reporting data across multiple bargaining units.

## HR, Payroll & Administration

• Oversee payroll administration, employee benefits, and HR-related budget impacts.

• Ensure compliance with collective agreements, employment legislation, and internal policies.

• Support hiring administration, attendance tracking, benefits coordination, and employee support processes.

• Promote a positive, inclusive workplace through strong HR and administrative practices.

• Oversee office operations, facilities, equipment, reception, and administrative support functions.

## National & Regional Support

• Serve as a financial and administrative resource to national leadership and regional offices.

• Provide guidance on financial procedures, compliance requirements, and administrative best practices.

• Identify opportunities to improve processes and strengthen shared services across the organization.

## Team Leadership

• Supervise and mentor a team of 3 Bookkeepers and 5 Accounting Assistants.

• Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

title: Director of Finance & Administration
description:
Our client is a successful, family-owned distribution business with a long-standing reputation for customer service, operational excellence, and strong relationships with customers and suppliers. As the company continues to evolve and grow, they are seeking a hands-on and commercially minded Director, Finance & Administration to oversee finance and key administrative functions across the organization. Reporting directly to the President, this is a unique opportunity to join a well-established business in a senior leadership role where you will have broad influence across Finance, Customer Service, Purchasing, Warehouse Operations, IT, and Administration.

## Key Responsibilities

## Finance & Treasury

• Lead daily cash management and rolling cash flow forecasting.

• Manage banking relationships, lending facilities, covenant reporting, and lender communications.

• Drive working capital performance through effective management of inventory, accounts receivable, and accounts payable.

• Prepare financial analysis and business cases supporting capital expenditures and operational investments.

• Monitor financial performance and provide recommendations to improve profitability and efficiency.

## Accounting & Reporting

• Lead the monthly, quarterly, and year-end close processes.

• Deliver accurate and timely financial statements and management reporting packages.

• Provide actionable analysis on profitability, product margins, customer performance, inventory aging, and logistics costs.

## Controls, Risk & Compliance

• Develop and strengthen internal controls and financial processes.

• Ensure compliance with lending agreements, tax regulations, insurance requirements, and corporate policies.

• Oversee annual insurance renewals and risk management initiatives.

• Coordinate tax filings and compliance activities with external advisors.

## Operational Leadership

• Lead and develop teams across Accounting, Customer Service, Purchasing, Warehouse Operations, and IT.

• Improve cross-functional processes including order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, inventory management, and customer service workflows.

• Oversee inventory planning, supplier performance, product availability, and working capital objectives.

• Provide leadership for payroll, benefits administration, recruiting, onboarding, information technology, and facilities management.

## Business Partnership

• Partner closely with the President to support budgeting, forecasting, and scenario planning activities.

• Deliver meaningful operational and financial insights that support business decisions.

• Act as a trusted advisor on the financial and operational health of the organization.

• Identify risks, opportunities, and process improvements while providing practical recommendations for action.

Assistant Controller

title: Financial Analyst
description:
We are looking for a Financial Analyst to support financial operations for a busy media environment in Toronto, Ontario. This Long-term Contract position will partner with production, studio operations, HR, IT, and finance teams to keep project finances organized, maintain accurate billing and payment activity, and support budget oversight for freelance and vendor-related work. The successful candidate will bring strong analytical ability, sound judgment, and a proactive approach to coordinating financial processes across multiple stakeholders.

Responsibilities:
• Coordinate with studio teams, HR, and IT to establish freelancers in the required financial and production systems so they can begin work efficiently.
• Lead onboarding support for freelance workers, including guidance on weekly processes and training on submitting job requests, purchase orders, and related financial documentation.
• Monitor completion of required training and approvals for freelancers, and work with internal partners to resolve access or system issues when they arise.
• Partner with studio and production leadership to forecast annual freelance resource needs and maintain associated budget plans for review and approval.
• Facilitate regular billing and financial review meetings with project stakeholders to track costs, resolve discrepancies, and support accurate reporting.
• Review vendor and freelancer invoices for completeness, obtain the necessary approvals, and coordinate timely submission for payment processing.
• Verify that freelancer time is charged to the correct projects each week and collaborate with producers to address missing or inconsistent entries.
• Support project financial administration by assigning or managing job numbers, maintaining accurate project statuses, and responding to billing-related questions from studio staff.
• Prepare and route financial request documentation for approvals, maintain organized tracking records, and contribute to ad hoc reporting as needed.

title: Senior Accounting Technician
description:
Nous recherchons un Technicien comptable pour se joindre à l’équipe de notre client à St-Hubert dans le cadre d’un contrat à long terme. Ce mandat offre une belle occasion de prendre en charge un cycle comptable complet dans un environnement PME dynamique où la rigueur, l’autonomie et le sens de l’analyse sont essentiels. La personne retenue contribuera aux activités financières quotidiennes, aux clôtures périodiques et aux échanges avec l’équipe américaine, tout en assurant l’exactitude des données et le respect des priorités d’affaires.

Responsabilités:

• Gérer l’ensemble du cycle comptable, incluant les comptes fournisseurs, les comptes clients, les rapprochements bancaires et le suivi des opérations financières courantes.

• Préparer et exécuter les paiements selon les échéanciers établis, notamment les traitements prioritaires pour les fournisseurs stratégiques et les paiements planifiés en semaine.

• Effectuer les clôtures de fin de mois et participer aux travaux de fin d’exercice afin d’assurer des dossiers complets, exacts et bien documentés.

• Analyser les écarts, repérer les anomalies comptables et résoudre les problèmes avec jugement et méthode dans un contexte où plusieurs tâches sont interreliées.

• Assurer le rapprochement de plusieurs comptes bancaires ainsi que le suivi des transactions intercompagnies avec l’entité américaine.

• Vérifier les mouvements de trésorerie, soutenir le suivi du flux de liquidités et coordonner les transferts requis avec les partenaires internes aux États-Unis.

• Collaborer avec les membres de l’équipe administrative et opérationnelle pour obtenir les pièces justificatives, valider l’information et maintenir des dossiers à jour.

• Produire et transmettre en anglais certains rapports, documents de soutien et informations financières demandés par l’équipe américaine sur une base régulière.

• Utiliser Excel et le système Label Track pour compiler l’information, effectuer les suivis nécessaires et soutenir l’exactitude des opérations comptables.

title: Project Accountant
Property Accountant
description:
We are looking for a Property Accountant to join a real estate and property organization in Richmond Hill, Ontario on a Long-term Contract basis. In this role, you will oversee accounting activities for a portfolio of properties while helping deliver accurate reporting, meaningful financial analysis, and dependable operational support. This opportunity is well suited to someone who enjoys working with detail-driven financial information, partnering with cross-functional teams, and identifying smarter ways to improve reporting and accounting processes.

Responsibilities:
• Manage complete accounting activities for an assigned property portfolio, including preparing journal entries, reconciling accounts, producing financial statements, and reviewing budget performance.
• Analyze monthly results by comparing actuals to forecasts and budgets, then explain notable variances and the factors influencing property performance.
• Provide accounting support for property transactions such as acquisitions, sales, refinancing, and related financing activities, including required financial setup and follow-up.
• Partner with teams across operations, corporate accounting, investor reporting, payroll, finance, acquisitions, and accounts payable to resolve questions and provide accurate financial insight.
• Contribute to broader portfolio reporting needs by supporting executive summaries, investor reporting packages, property tax matters, reconciliation activities, and lender-related requirements.
• Assist with external and investor-related audits by preparing supporting documentation, responding to requests, and helping ensure timely completion of deliverables.
• Prepare year-end working papers and schedules, and support the review of U.S. partnership tax return information for investors where required.
• Evaluate existing workflows and recommend practical improvements that enhance efficiency, strengthen controls, and support more effective reporting and analysis.

title: Payroll Specialist
Payroll Specialist
description:
Notre client, situé à Montréal, recherche un spécialiste à la paie pour se joindre à son équipe des finances dans le cadre d’un contrat de 12 mois. Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable du cycle complet de la paie aux deux semaines pour un effectif de plusieurs dizaines d'employés syndiqués et non syndiqués. Ce poste offre un horaire flexible de 37,5 heures par semaine avec un mode de travail hybride comprenant trois jours au bureau et deux jours en télétravail. Vous contribuerez également aux activités de production de rapports, de préparation aux audits et de comptabilisation liées à la paie.

Responsabilités :

• Gérer le cycle complet de la paie aux deux semaines pour environ 71 employés, en veillant à l’exactitude des données et au respect des échéanciers.

• Administrer les opérations de paie dans Nethris et assurer le suivi des ajustements liés à la rémunération, aux avantages et aux retenues applicables.

• Produire, valider et mettre à jour les rapports de paie et de fin de mois, puis transférer l’information requise dans Excel pour fins d’analyse et de contrôle.

• Collaborer avec le directeur des finances ainsi qu’avec l’équipe de finance et d’administration afin de soutenir les activités courantes liées à la paie.

• Préparer les écritures de journal associées à la paie et vérifier la concordance des informations comptables avant leur intégration aux dossiers financiers.

• Répondre aux demandes internes concernant la paie en tenant compte des réalités propres aux employés syndiqués et non syndiqués.

• Fournir la documentation et les explications nécessaires aux vérificateurs et contribuer activement aux activités de préparation d’audit.

• Participer, au besoin, à l’amélioration des outils de suivi et des méthodes de production de rapports liés à la paie et à l’administration financière.

title: Credit Analyst
description:
Nous recherchons une personne rigoureuse et organisée pour se joindre à l'équipe de notre client à Dorval au sein du secteur de la distribution en gros. Ce poste de Coordonnateur au crédit convient à une personne capable d’équilibrer l'analyse financière, le suivi administratif rigoureux et la gestion proactive des risques. Le titulaire jouera un rôle clé dans la gestion des comptes clients, le processus de recouvrement et, de façon prioritaire, dans la gestion approfondie des dénonciations (liens) et la protection des créance

Responsabilités:

• Gérer les comptes en souffrance, coordonner les activités de recouvrement et faire appel à des partenaires externes lorsque la situation l’exige.

• Examiner les demandes de nouveaux clients, analyser leur profil financier et formuler des recommandations liées à l’octroi de crédit.

• Échanger avec les agences spécialisées afin d’obtenir des renseignements pertinents sur la solvabilité et l’historique de paiement des clients.

• Travailler de concert avec l’équipe des ventes pour mettre en place des approches efficaces favorisant la récupération des créances.

• Assurer le suivi des dossiers nécessitant une dénonciation, préparer les pièces justificatives requises et veiller à l’exactitude de la documentation.

• Produire des rapports liés aux comptes clients, aux indicateurs de performance et aux tendances observées pour appuyer la prise de décision.

• Réviser les pratiques de crédit et de recouvrement, puis proposer des pistes d’amélioration afin de réduire le risque et d’accroître l’efficacité.

• Soutenir les opérations administratives régionales, notamment la gestion des dossiers, le traitement des demandes courantes, la vérification de crédits fournisseurs et le suivi de certains rapports d’achats.

• Effectuer des tâches de contrôle telles que la validation d’erreurs d’expédition, le traitement des ventes au comptant, le rapprochement de caisse et la gestion des fournitures de bureau.

title: Cost Analyst
description:
Are you a finance professional who enjoys working closely with operations and understanding how products are built from the ground up? Our client is seeking a Cost Analyst to join their team in a state-of-the-art manufacturing facility supporting one of the world's largest retailers.

This is a highly visible role within an international organization where you'll partner with finance, operations, and commercial teams to drive profitability, improve costing accuracy, and support key business decisions. The position offers a unique blend of product costing, ERP systems management, financial analysis, and business partnering.

## What You'll Do

• Own and maintain Bills of Materials (BOMs), ensuring costing data is accurate and up to date across all products.

• Manage product costing for both new product development (NPD) and existing product lines.

• Analyze manufacturing performance, including material yields, labour efficiency, overhead absorption, and standard costing variances.

• Partner with plant leadership to provide insights and recommendations that improve operational and financial performance.

• Prepare weekly, monthly, and quarterly financial and operational reporting.

• Support budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting processes.

• Develop and enhance reporting and dashboards using Power BI and Excel.

• Ensure financial information within SAP S/4HANA and related systems is accurate and supports effective decision-making.

• Participate in continuous improvement initiatives, process enhancements, and ad hoc projects across the business.

• Present financial information to non-finance stakeholders and act as a key liaison between finance and operations.

## Why Join?

• Work in a modern, high-growth manufacturing facility.

• Partner with one of the world's largest retail customers.

• Gain exposure to international operations and senior leadership.

• Highly collaborative environment with significant interaction across finance, operations, and commercial teams.

• Opportunity to make a direct impact on profitability, process improvement, and business performance.

title: Accounting Manager
description:
Our Niagara Region client is seeking a CPA-designated accounting professional to join their finance team as Accounting Manager. Reporting directly to the Divisional Controller, this role plays a key part in ensuring the accuracy and integrity of financial reporting, supporting budgeting and forecasting activities, and providing meaningful financial analysis to operations and senior leadership. This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on CPA who enjoys partnering with the business, leading reporting processes, mentoring staff, and driving continuous improvement initiatives.

## What You'll Be Doing

title: Accounting Coordinator
description:
Our client is seeking an organized, detail-oriented Accounting Clerk to support the day-to-day financial operations of their business. This hands-on role will be responsible for a variety of accounts receivable and accounts payable activities, ensuring transactions are processed accurately, payments are recorded appropriately, and financial records remain organized and up to date.

The successful candidate will play an important role in supporting the Finance team and working collaboratively with colleagues across the organization. This opportunity is well suited for someone who takes ownership of their work, demonstrates initiative, and enjoys working in a fast-paced environment where accuracy, responsiveness, and teamwork are valued.

Key Responsibilities and Duties

Accounts Receivable (A/R)

• Process and record customer invoices on a daily basis.

• Accurately record customer payments received through EFT, cheque, cash, and debit/credit transactions.

• Prepare and deposit customer cheques and cash payments in a timely manner.

• Generate weekly customer account statements and coordinate distribution as required.

• Monitor outstanding customer balances and follow up on overdue accounts in accordance with established payment terms.

• Manage incoming accounts receivable correspondence, ensuring payments are accurately applied based on customer remittance information.

• Work closely with the sales team to investigate and resolve customer credit inquiries and discrepancies.

• Reconcile daily invoices against supporting shipping and delivery documentation to ensure accuracy.

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date accounts receivable records.

Accounts Payable (A/P)

• Review, code, and enter vendor invoices into the accounting system, identifying discrepancies and following up with vendors as needed.

• Review and process employee expense claims, ensuring appropriate documentation and accuracy.

• Prepare and process weekly payments, including cheques, wire transfers, electronic funds transfers, and online bill payments.

• Prepare and distribute vendor remittance information.

• Monitor vendor payment terms and ensure invoices are paid accurately and on time.

• Manage the accounts payable email inbox, responding to vendor inquiries and resolving payment-related issues.

• Maintain the accounts payable subledger.

• Identify and investigate invoice discrepancies, working with internal departments and external vendors to resolve outstanding issues.

Qualifications and Experience

• Previous experience in an accounting or bookkeeping role, with exposure to both accounts payable and accounts receivable.

• Basic understanding of accounting principles and financial processes.

• Experience with accounting software and Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.

• Strong data entry skills with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.

• Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to investigate discrepancies, ask questions, and proactively resolve issues.

• A team-oriented mindset with a willingness to support broader accounting activities as required.

title: SFA
description:

title: Payroll Analyst, Finance
description:
Robert Half is partnering with a well respected organization that's looking to add an experienced Payroll Analyst to their team. This is a full-time/permanent role on site.

## Advantages:

-Competitive salary (70-88K)

-Full benefits + defined pension

-3 weeks vacation + 20 sick days

-Free parking

-Great team & team culture

## Responsibilities:

• Process all bi-weekly payrolls for the organization, including separate payroll cycles for full-time and part-time employees.

• Calculate regular pay, benefit entitlements, overtime, salary overrides, and other applicable earnings.

• Oversee and monitor on-call payments and maintain on-call logs.

• Review payroll for accuracy and ensure compliance with organizational policies, procedures, legislation, and collective agreements.

• Verify coding, calculations, and supporting People and Culture documentation prior to payroll transmission.

• Ensure payroll changes align with approved program budget requirements.

• Balance payroll and submit finalized payroll data to the third-party provider for processing.

• Prepare, administer, and monitor documentation and correspondence related to garnishments.

• Maintain payroll and pension procedures documentation in coordination with People and Culture.

• Provide backup support for payroll administration during leave coverage.

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee payroll records.

• Track and process new hires, terminations, and employee changes.

• Prepare Records of Employment (ROEs) and annual T4/T4A slips.

• Verify payroll entries for employees changing status between full-time and part-time.

• Reconcile payroll-related accounts on a monthly basis.

• Prepare and submit monthly reports, remittances, and data transfers accurately and on time, including WSIB, EHT, CPP, EI, pension, union deductions, charitable donations, and tax remittances.

• Ensure payroll journal entries are processed accurately and posted to the accounting system on a timely basis.

• Maintain the payroll database through file imports from the payroll processing system.

• Ensure payroll hours are coded correctly for full-time equivalent (FTE) reporting.

description:

• Track working capital performance, including work-in-progress and inventory, and identify opportunities to strengthen efficiency and cash flow.

title: Controller
description:
Our client, a growing North American subsidiary of a global organization, is seeking an experienced Controller to lead its accounting and finance function. Reporting to executive leadership, the Controller will oversee financial reporting, compliance, treasury, budgeting, internal controls, and team leadership while serving as a key liaison with the organization's international finance teams.

This is a hands-on leadership position that combines strategic oversight with day-to-day involvement in complex accounting and financial matters. The successful candidate will play a key role in strengthening processes, developing team capabilities, and supporting ongoing business growth.

## Key Responsibilities

Financial Leadership & Reporting

• Lead month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close processes.

• Oversee preparation and review of financial statements, management reporting, and balance sheet reconciliations.

• Develop budgets, forecasts, and financial analysis to support business decisions.

• Ensure timely and accurate reporting to executive leadership and global finance stakeholders.

Team Leadership

• Manage, mentor, and develop the accounting team.

• Establish strong internal controls, review procedures, and accountability measures.

• Standardize processes and implement cross-training initiatives to improve operational effectiveness.

• Provide guidance on complex accounting and operational issues.

Compliance, Tax & Audit

• Oversee corporate tax compliance, indirect tax filings, and regulatory requirements.

• Serve as the primary contact for external auditors and manage annual audit processes.

• Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and corporate policies.

Treasury & Working Capital

• Manage cash flow, banking relationships, and treasury activities.

• Monitor working capital requirements and provide visibility into liquidity and financial performance.

• Support foreign currency and intercompany transaction management.

Systems & Process Improvement

• Lead finance process improvement initiatives.

• Participate in ERP evaluation, implementation, and optimization projects.

• Drive efficiencies through automation, controls, and best practices.

title: Director of Accounting
description:
Our client is a well-established and growing residential home builder and land developer with a strong reputation for creating exceptional communities across the GTA. With a robust pipeline of future development projects, the organization is seeking an experienced and hands-on Controller to lead its finance and accounting function.

Reporting directly to the President, the Controller will play a key leadership role in overseeing financial operations, managing a high-performing accounting team, and providing strategic financial guidance to support continued growth.

Position Summary

The Controller will be responsible for all aspects of financial reporting, project accounting, budgeting, treasury management, and internal controls. This individual will partner closely with operations, construction, development, and executive leadership to ensure accurate financial reporting and effective financial management across multiple projects and entities.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Reporting & Accounting

• Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting process.

• Prepare and review consolidated financial statements and supporting schedules.

• Ensure compliance with ASPE, and relevant regulatory requirements.

• Oversee general ledger, account reconciliations, and month-end close activities.

• Manage year-end audits and liaise with external auditors, tax advisors, and financial institutions.

• Monitor and improve accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls.

Construction & Project Accounting

• Oversee accounting for residential construction and land development projects.

• Monitor project budgets, costs, profitability, and cash flow forecasts.

• Analyze project performance and provide detailed reporting to senior management.

• Review construction draws, development expenditures, lot inventories, and project allocations.

• Ensure timely and accurate capitalization of development and construction costs.

• Oversee joint venture and partnership accounting where applicable.

Treasury & Cash Management

• Manage corporate cash flow, liquidity, and banking relationships.

• Prepare short and long-term cash flow forecasts.

• Support financing activities, lender reporting, and covenant compliance.

• Monitor project financing requirements and funding draws.

Leadership & Team Management

• Lead, mentor, and develop the accounting and finance team.

• Establish performance objectives and promote professional development.

• Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

• Partner with operational leaders to support strategic decision-making.

Strategic Finance

• Support annual budgeting and forecasting processes.

• Provide financial analysis and recommendations to executive leadership.

• Assist with acquisition, development, financing, and investment evaluations.

• Contribute to system enhancements, process improvements, and operational efficiencies.

title: Corporate Controller
description:
Reporting to the VP of Finance, the Corporate Controller will lead financial reporting and accounting operations across a growing, multi-entity manufacturing organization. This is a hands-on, high-visibility role with responsibility for the close process, manufacturing costing, inventory, budgeting, controls, systems improvements, acquisitions, and leadership of a small accounting team.

The Controller will also play a key role in ERP standardization, acquisition integration, AP automation, inventory improvements, and building the finance infrastructure needed to support continued growth and future external audits.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual close, financial reporting, reconciliations, intercompany transactions, and management reporting.

• Standardize accounting policies, processes, controls, and the chart of accounts across multiple entities.

• Oversee budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, cash flow, and working capital management.

• Analyze manufacturing costs, margins, standard costing, WIP, and inventory valuation to identify opportunities for improved profitability and efficiency.

• Strengthen inventory controls, cycle counting, tracking, and reporting.

• Lead ERP and financial systems integration, including onboarding newly acquired businesses.

• Drive process improvements and automation, including accounts payable automation.

• Support acquisition integration, year-end reporting, tax requirements, and preparation for external audits.

• Provide financial analysis and recommendations to senior leadership to support business decisions and growth.

• Lead, coach, and develop a small accounting team while remaining hands-on with day-to-day finance operations.

• Participate in process improvement initiatives

Cost Accountant
description:
We are looking for a Cost Accountant to join a manufacturing operation in Waterloo, Ontario and provide reliable financial insight that supports sound production and purchasing decisions. This position focuses on maintaining accurate product costing, reviewing operational variances, and delivering timely reporting that helps leaders understand plant performance. The successful candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams to strengthen cost controls, improve data accuracy, and contribute to budgeting and ongoing efficiency initiatives.

Responsibilities:
� Maintain standard cost information by reviewing historical data, validating assumptions, and updating costing records to reflect current operating conditions.
� Refresh raw material cost standards on a regular monthly cycle using forecast information supplied by the purchasing team.
� Verify that production recipes and process specifications reflect accurate run rates and labour assumptions for costing purposes.
� Investigate purchasing and material usage variances to identify discrepancies and keep bills of material and standard costs aligned with actual operations.
� Prepare cost models for new items, product changes, and initiatives aimed at reducing manufacturing spend.
� Collaborate with Purchasing, Research and Development, and Manufacturing to support cost approvals, track labour-related variances, and assess financial results after product launches.
� Produce recurring operational finance reports covering areas such as purchase price variance, labour performance, yield, inventory movements, production volumes, and overhead spending.
� Reconcile income statement activity by reviewing variance-related transactions and correcting inconsistencies where required.
� Analyze plant expenses and prepare journal entries related to labour, utilities, and inventory account reconciliations.
� Assist with the annual budgeting process and support cost-reduction efforts in partnership with operational finance leadership.

title: Corporate Accounting Manager
description:
## The Opportunity

Our client, an established organization in the financial services and investment management sector, is seeking a Corporate Accounting Manager to join its collaborative finance team.

This is a highly hands-on accounting opportunity within a lean, flat organizational structure, offering broad exposure to corporate accounting, financial reporting, operational finance, and process improvement. While carrying a Manager title, the position is primarily an individual contributor role, ideal for an experienced Senior Accountant or newly designated CPA looking to take ownership of core accounting functions without direct people management responsibilities.

The successful candidate will work closely with senior finance leadership and collaborate with a Fund Accounting Manager, with opportunities for cross-training and exposure to fund accounting activities.

## Key Responsibilities

• Manage day-to-day corporate accounting activities, including general ledger maintenance, journal entries, accruals, reconciliations, and month-end close.

• Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in accordance with ASPE and IFRS, as applicable.

• Oversee operational accounting activities, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance with internal policies and accounting standards.

• Support investor reporting, regulatory filings, and other financial reporting requirements.

• Prepare working papers, reconciliations, and supporting schedules for external audits and year-end reporting.

• Collaborate with the Fund Accounting Manager and participate in cross-training initiatives to build knowledge of fund accounting processes and provide coverage as required.

• Identify opportunities to strengthen accounting processes, internal controls, and operational efficiencies.

• Support accounting systems enhancements and technology-related initiatives.

• Work closely with senior management and external advisors on accounting, reporting, and compliance matters.

• Participate in ad hoc accounting projects and initiatives as required.

title: Controller
description:
Nous recherchons un Controller pour soutenir les opérations financières d’une usine de transformation de volaille située à Lévis, Québec. Ce rôle combine supervision, contrôle financier et accompagnement des activités quotidiennes de l’établissement. La personne retenue contribuera à la fiabilité de l’information financière, à l’encadrement des processus budgétaires et à la production de rapports utiles à la prise de décision.

Responsibilities:

• Assurer la supervision des activités comptables et financières de l’usine afin de maintenir des résultats exacts et conformes aux objectifs de l’entreprise.

• Préparer, analyser et présenter les rapports financiers périodiques en mettant en évidence les écarts, les tendances et les pistes d’action.

• Coordonner les processus budgétaires et les prévisions financières pour appuyer la planification opérationnelle du site.

• Veiller au traitement adéquat de la paie et des fonctions comptables connexes, en collaboration avec les intervenants concernés.

• Utiliser les systèmes financiers et outils de reporting pour produire des analyses ponctuelles et répondre aux besoins de la direction.

• Encadrer et soutenir les membres de l’équipe sous sa responsabilité afin d’assurer un fonctionnement efficace et rigoureux.

• Participer à l’amélioration continue des pratiques de contrôle et de reddition de comptes au sein de l’usine.

• Collaborer avec les partenaires internes pour fournir des informations financières fiables favorisant des décisions d’affaires éclairées

title: Payroll Manager
description:
Nous recherchons un(e) gestionnaire de la paie pour se joindre à une organisation établie à Lévis, Québec. Cette personne jouera un rôle clé dans l’exactitude et la conformité des opérations de paie pour une main-d’œuvre syndiquée d’environ 800 employés, tout en assurant une collaboration étroite avec les équipes des ressources humaines et des finances. Le poste convient à une personne ayant le souci du détail, capable d’évoluer dans un environnement sur site et de soutenir des processus de paie complexes avec rigueur et jugement.

Responsibilities:

• Superviser l’ensemble du cycle de paie et veiller au traitement précis et ponctuel des rémunérations pour une population d’employés syndiqués.

• Encadrer les activités quotidiennes liées à la paie, aux avantages sociaux et aux retenues, en assurant le respect des politiques internes et des obligations réglementaires.

• Analyser les écarts, résoudre les problèmes de paie complexes et recommander des correctifs durables afin de réduire les erreurs récurrentes.

• Collaborer avec les équipes des ressources humaines, de la comptabilité et des opérations pour assurer l’intégrité des données qui alimentent la paie.

• Produire, vérifier et concilier les rapports de paie, les remises obligatoires et les données nécessaires aux audits internes ou externes.

• Administrer et optimiser l’utilisation des systèmes de paie et de gestion du temps, notamment Kronos, ADP Workforce Now, Ceridian ou d’autres plateformes comparables.

• Soutenir, au besoin, les ajustements de processus ou d’outils liés à la paie en veillant à limiter les impacts opérationnels et à maintenir la conformité.

• Agir comme personne-ressource pour les questions relatives aux taxes salariales, aux avantages et aux pratiques de paie, en offrant des conseils clairs aux parties prenantes.

title: Senior Customer Service Representative
description:
We are looking for a Sr. Customer Service Representative to join a machinery manufacturing organization in Toronto, Ontario on a Long-term Contract basis. This position acts as a key point of contact for customers while coordinating with sales, production, logistics, and finance to ensure orders move efficiently from initial request through final delivery. The role also contributes to forecast visibility, documentation accuracy, and timely communication, helping create a dependable customer experience and strong operational support across the business.

• Oversee the complete order cycle, including order entry, documentation review, status follow-up, and delivery coordination to ensure accuracy and timeliness.
• Respond to customer inquiries regarding product availability, expected lead times, shipment progress, and delivery schedules with clear and proactive communication.
• Maintain well-organized customer records, including commercial agreements, contracts, correspondence, and supporting account documentation.
• Administer customer portal activities such as purchase order confirmations, shipment document uploads, and advance shipping notifications.
• Work closely with sales, manufacturing, and logistics teams to prevent order discrepancies and support smooth fulfilment activities.
• Monitor outstanding receivables, send account-related updates to customers, and escalate overdue payment issues that may affect future shipments.
• Support sales planning by reviewing opportunity pipelines, highlighting items approaching expected close dates, and contributing to quarterly shipment and revenue forecasts.
• Analyse forecast performance against actual results, prepare funnel and conversion updates, and provide information that supports planning discussions.
• Coordinate finance-related customer documentation, including reconciliations, guarantees, letters of credit, and audit support requirements.
• Prepare and process customer and vendor paperwork, including proforma invoices and inspection-related documents, while ensuring shipment documentation meets required standards.

title: Buyer
description:
Our client, a growing and dynamic manufacturing organization in the Vaughan area, is seeking a highly capable Buyer to take ownership of the procurement function and play a key role in supporting business growth and operational success.

This is an excellent opportunity for a confident procurement professional who enjoys working independently, influencing decisions, and collaborating directly with executive leadership. The successful candidate will bring strong manufacturing purchasing experience, exceptional communication skills, and the ability to build credibility with suppliers, internal stakeholders, and senior leaders alike.

As a trusted procurement partner, you will be responsible for ensuring the uninterrupted flow of materials, managing supplier relationships, driving cost savings initiatives, and contributing to strategic supply chain decisions that impact the business.

## Responsibilities:

• Lead all purchasing and sourcing activities to support manufacturing operations and business objectives.

• Develop and implement procurement strategies that improve cost, quality, delivery, and supplier performance.

• Source and negotiate with suppliers for raw materials, components, and production-related services.

• Manage RFQ and tendering processes, evaluate vendor proposals, and negotiate favorable commercial agreements.

• Build strong relationships with key suppliers while holding them accountable for quality, pricing, and delivery expectations.

• Partner closely with the Executive Leadership Team to provide procurement insights, recommendations, and market intelligence.

• Collaborate with Production, Engineering, Quality, Operations, Finance, and Logistics to ensure material availability and operational continuity.

• Monitor inventory levels and supplier performance to proactively identify and mitigate supply risks.

• Analyze purchasing data, spending trends, and supplier metrics to support informed decision-making.

• Identify and implement opportunities for cost savings, process improvements, and supplier rationalization.

• Support supplier qualification, audits, and continuous improvement initiatives.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Vous souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement stable, collaboratif et humain, où la qualité de vie et l’équilibre professionnel occupent une place importante? Notre client, une entité parapublique reconnue, est à la recherche d’un Comptable afin de se joindre à une petite équipe où la collaboration et le partage des connaissances sont au cœur du quotidien.

Relevant de la Vice-Présidente, la personne en poste travaillera en étroite collaboration avec un collègue occupant les mêmes fonctions ainsi qu’avec une équipe de techniciens comptables. Au-delà des compétences techniques, le poste s’adresse à une personne structurée, proactive et rassembleuse, qui souhaite contribuer à l’évolution de l’équipe et éventuellement jouer un rôle accru dans son développement.

Pourquoi joindre cette équipe?
• Environ huit (8) semaines de congé incluant 10 journées monnayables;
• Régime de retraite à prestations déterminées et assurances collectives complètes, et augmentations salariales statutaires;
• Environnement syndiqué offrant une excellente stabilité;
• Télétravail à raison d’environ 90 % du temps;
• Petite équipe favorisant la proximité, l’entraide et le partage des connaissances;
• Environnement de travail très collaboratif et ouvert aux questions;
• Bureau fermé et horaire flexible;

TÂCHES

• Superviser les activités liées aux comptes clients et fournisseurs et assurer le bon déroulement des opérations comptables courantes.
• Participer à la gestion de la trésorerie, incluant les prévisions de décaissements, le suivi des liquidités et des placements.
• Assurer le suivi comptable des immobilisations, des amortissements et des autres éléments liés aux actifs.
• Contribuer à la fermeture mensuelle, aux analyses de comptes ainsi qu’à la préparation des états financiers et des dossiers de fin d’exercice.
• Veiller au respect des obligations fiscales et préparer les remises de TPS, TVH et TVQ.
• Collaborer aux travaux d’audit externe et fournir les analyses et informations requises.
• Maintenir à jour certaines données financières utilisées pour la facturation et assurer leur fiabilité.
• Coordonner le travail des ressources sous sa responsabilité et agir comme personne-ressource auprès des utilisateurs de certains systèmes administratifs.
• Préparer les informations nécessaires à la production des feuillets fiscaux et effectuer certains contrôles comptables auprès d’entités connexes.
• Identifier les occasions d’amélioration et contribuer à l’optimisation des processus et des pratiques comptables.
• Effectuer toute autre tâche connexe.
