Position: Accounts Payable & Accounting Technician
Location: Laval, Québec
Position: Full-time, Permanent
Work Arrangement: On-site, 5 days per week
Schedule: Monday to Friday, with a choice of 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. or 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.

About the Opportunity

Are you an organized, detail-oriented accounting professional who enjoys taking ownership of your work and being part of a close-knit team?

We are looking for an Accounts Payable & Accounting Technician to join an established general contracting business in Laval, Québec. With more than 30 years in the construction industry and a small, collaborative team, this is an opportunity to build meaningful working relationships, contribute to day-to-day operations, and continue developing your accounting skills.

You will work closely with the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and a small accounting and administration team in a hands-on role where accuracy, initiative, and teamwork make a real difference.

Accounts payable will be your primary responsibility, with additional involvement in general accounting, bookkeeping, and occasional accounts receivable coverage. If you enjoy variety, appreciate having responsibility over your work, and take pride in keeping things organized and running smoothly, this could be an excellent fit for you.

What You'll Be Doing

Accounts Payable & Construction Administration

You will take ownership of the accounts payable process, helping ensure that supplier and subcontractor invoices are processed accurately, payments are prepared on time, and project records remain complete and up to date.

Your responsibilities will include:

- Managing the full accounts payable cycle, from receiving and verifying invoices to coding and entering them into the accounting system.
- Ensuring expenses are allocated accurately to the appropriate construction projects and cost categories.
- Reconciling supplier statements, investigating discrepancies, and following up to resolve outstanding issues.
- Preparing supplier payments and maintaining accurate accounts payable records.
- Communicating with suppliers and subcontractors regarding invoices, credits, payments, and account balances.
- Tracking construction holdbacks and ensuring they are recorded and released appropriately.
- Following up on construction contract notices, releases and waivers, and other documents required for subcontractor payments.
- Verifying and maintaining supplier and subcontractor compliance documents, including Revenu Québec tax compliance certificates, CNESST certificates, RBQ licences where applicable, and certificates of insurance.
- Monitoring document expiry dates and coordinating renewals when needed.
- Working with project managers and subcontractors to ensure invoices, payment documentation, and supporting records are accurate and complete.
- Keeping supplier, subcontractor, and project accounting files organized and up to date.

General Accounting & Bookkeeping

Alongside accounts payable, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to a variety of accounting activities and develop a broader understanding of the business's financial operations.

This includes:

- Performing day-to-day bookkeeping and general accounting tasks.
- Assisting with bank and credit card reconciliations.
- Preparing journal entries and maintaining accurate accounting records.
- Supporting month-end and year-end accounting procedures.
- Assisting with project costing, expense tracking, and account reconciliations.
- Preparing Excel schedules, reconciliations, and financial reports as required.

Accounts Receivable Support

You'll also provide occasional backup support to the accounts receivable function during vacations or absences, helping the team maintain continuity in its daily operations.

This may include:

- Assisting with customer invoicing and payment processing.
- Recording and applying customer payments.
- Reconciling customer accounts.
- Following up on outstanding receivables and collections as needed.

What We're Looking For

We're interested in someone who brings a solid accounting foundation, a strong sense of responsibility, and a genuine interest in doing their work well.

Ideally, you will have:

- A diploma in accounting, bookkeeping, or a related field (DEP, AEC, DEC, or equivalent).
- Approximately 2–5 years of relevant experience in accounts payable, bookkeeping, or general accounting.
- Excellent written and spoken French.
- Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including preparing reconciliations and analyzing financial information.
- Experience with QuickBooks Enterprise or similar accounting software; QuickBooks Enterprise experience is an asset.
- A good understanding of accounting principles and bookkeeping practices.
- Experience in construction accounting, including project costing, subcontractor invoices, and holdbacks, is an asset.
- Familiarity with Québec construction documentation and compliance requirements, including contract notices, releases and waivers, CNESST, RBQ, and Revenu Québec documentation, is an asset.

Other Language Requirement: English
- Level of Proficiency Required: Intermediate
- Reason for Language Requirement: Communication with clients
- Frequency of Use: Regularly (a few times a week)

You don't need to know everything on day one. A solid accounting foundation, a willingness to learn, and the ability to take ownership of your responsibilities are important.

The Qualities That Will Help You Succeed

You'll likely enjoy this role if you are someone who:

- Takes pride in accuracy and notices the small details that matter.
- Is organized, dependable, and comfortable managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
- Understands the importance of accurate project cost allocation and complete documentation.
- Takes initiative, looks for solutions, and follows through on commitments.
- Can work independently while knowing when to ask questions or collaborate with others.
- Communicates professionally and builds positive working relationships with suppliers, subcontractors, and colleagues.
- Enjoys working in a smaller team where flexibility, cooperation, and mutual support are valued.
- Is motivated to learn, grow, and gradually take on additional responsibilities.

What You Can Expect

This opportunity offers more than a routine accounts payable position. It's a chance to become a valued member of a small team, work directly with the CFO, and gain exposure to different aspects of accounting within the construction industry.

You'll benefit from:

- A welcoming, close-knit team: Work in a professional environment where collaboration and good working relationships matter.
- A stable, permanent position: Join an established business with more than 30 years of industry experience.
- A varied, hands-on role: Take on meaningful responsibilities across accounts payable, bookkeeping, and general accounting.
- Direct access to the CFO: Work closely with senior financial leadership and gain insight into the business's financial operations.
- Opportunities to grow: Continue developing your accounting knowledge and expand your responsibilities over time.
- A consistent weekday schedule: Monday to Friday, with the flexibility to choose between 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m. and 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.

Interested in This Opportunity?

If you're an accounting professional who enjoys being hands-on, values accuracy, and wants to be part of a supportive team where your contributions are appreciated, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today to Yashar Eskandari at yashar.eskandari@quantum.ca and explore whether this opportunity is the right next step in your accounting career.

• Monitor aging reports and proactively follow up on overdue accounts.

• Process cash applications, wire transfers, EFTs, and other customer payments.

• Ability to prioritize workload and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

I am looking for a senior accountant for an insurance company on Montreal’s South Shore

title: Senior Credit Risk Advisor
description:
Nous recherchons un conseiller principal en risque de crédit pour se joindre à une équipe qui soutient l’analyse des contreparties et la gestion d’un portefeuille de risques à Montréal, Québec. Dans ce rôle de type Analyste d'affaires, la personne retenue contribuera aux décisions de crédit, à la surveillance continue des expositions et à l’amélioration des pratiques de gestion du risque en partenariat avec les équipes d’affaires. Il s’agit d’un role dans un mode de travail hybride nécessitant une présence au bureau au moins trois jours par semaine. Un excellent niveau d’anglais est important pour interagir avec les partenaires d’affaires, et le bilinguisme français-anglais constitue un atout.

Responsabilités:

• Évaluer les dossiers de nouvelles et de nouvelles contreparties existantes à partir d’analyses quantitatives et qualitatives afin de recommander des cotes de crédit, des limites, des modalités de paiement et des solutions adaptées au niveau de risque.

• Assurer la gestion quotidienne d’un portefeuille assigné en réalisant les revues de crédit, le suivi des demandes liées aux transactions potentielles, la vérification des disponibilités de limites et le traitement des demandes d’intégration et de levée de blocages.

• Travailler étroitement avec les unités d’affaires et groupes partenaires pour gérer les événements de crédit, notamment lors de l’intégration de contreparties, des retards de paiement, des défauts ou d’autres situations à risque.

• Examiner des transactions complexes avec les équipes commerciales et fonctions partenaires afin de structurer des protections de crédit appropriées et de définir des conditions contractuelles adéquates.

• Coordonner les échanges avec les assureurs-crédit, courtiers et partenaires internes tels que les équipes juridiques et financières pour mettre en place des mesures de mitigation comme des garanties, des modalités de paiement ou des déclencheurs contractuels.

• Surveiller quotidiennement le portefeuille à l’aide des outils, rapports et renseignements de marché disponibles, puis signaler rapidement toute détérioration du profil de risque ou tout événement défavorable.

• Produire, valider et présenter des rapports et analyses sur l’exposition, le vieillissement des comptes clients, les prévisions de ventes, les dépassements de limites et d’autres indicateurs utiles à la gouvernance du crédit.

• Veiller au respect des cadres de gouvernance et des contrôles de crédit en identifiant les écarts, en documentant les bris de limites et en soutenant la mise en conformité des processus de suivi.

• Contribuer à l’optimisation de la fonction risque de crédit en pilotant la standardisation, l’automatisation et l’amélioration continue des processus, incluant l’utilisation de systèmes de gestion du risque et d’outils analytiques.

• Appuyer les initiatives et projets liés aux systèmes de risque de crédit et à l’évolution des pratiques opérationnelles, lorsque requis, en collaboration avec les parties prenantes concernées.r

• Expérience significative en analyse du risque de crédit, en gestion de portefeuille de contreparties ou dans un rôle comparable en finance corporative.

• Solide capacité à interpréter des données financières et opérationnelles afin de formuler des recommandations de crédit éclairées.

• Maîtrise des outils de reporting et d’analyse, notamment Microsoft Excel; une connaissance de Python ou d’outils d’automatisation représente un atout.

• Aptitude démontrée à communiquer efficacement avec des interlocuteurs d’affaires, des équipes de vente, de marketing, de finance et des partenaires externes.

• Excellente maîtrise de l’anglais à l’oral et à l’écrit afin de communiquer régulièrement avec les partenaires hors-Québec.

• Connaissance des pratiques de surveillance du crédit, des limites d’exposition, des processus d’onboarding et des mécanismes de mitigation du risque.

• Capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités, à répondre à des demandes ponctuelles et à évoluer dans un environnement exigeant axé sur la qualité des décisions.

• Disponibilité pour travailler en mode hybride à Montréal, Québec, avec une présence minimale de trois jours par semaine au bureau.

*L'emploi du genre masculin a pour but d'alléger le texte et d'en faciliter la lecture.

title: Business Process Owner (BPO)
description:
Hello! My name is Angela, and I am a Recruitment Consultant at Fed Supply, a specialized recruitment agency focused on supply chain, logistics, transportation, and customer service. We recruit for both temporary and permanent positions throughout the Greater Montreal Area.

Mission
The Company
Our client, a well-established manufacturing company undergoing a major transformation, is looking for a Business Process Owner (BPO) – Procure-to-Pay to play a key role in modernizing its operations and implementing Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365).
This position offers the opportunity to contribute to a strategic transformation project, with a direct impact on purchasing, procurement, and supplier management processes.

The Role
Reporting to the Business Process Manager, the successful candidate will be responsible for the design, standardization, and continuous improvement of the end-to-end Procure-to-Pay process, from supplier management through payment.
Acting as a functional subject matter expert, the BPO will work closely with Purchasing, Procurement, Finance, Operations, and IT teams to define future-state processes and support their integration into D365.
This is a cross-functional role with no direct reports, combining procurement expertise, business process analysis, ERP transformation, and change management.
Key Responsibilities
• Analyze, document, and optimize Procure-to-Pay (P2P) processes, including direct and indirect purchasing, supplier management, purchase orders, receiving, and invoicing.
• Identify inefficiencies and define future-state processes as part of the D365 implementation.
• Translate Purchasing and Procurement requirements into functional system specifications.
• Participate in functional testing, solution validation, data cleansing, and migration preparation.
• Collaborate with Finance, Production, Maintenance, Inventory, and IT teams to ensure seamless process integration.
• Develop process documentation, procedures, and key performance indicators (KPIs).
• Support users through training, process adoption, and change management initiatives.
• Contribute to system deployment, post-implementation support, and continuous improvement activities.

Your profile
Candidate Profile
• Approximately 3–5+ years of experience in purchasing, procurement, or business process management.
• Manufacturing experience is essential, with a solid understanding of raw materials, MRP, and production requirements.
• Strong understanding of Procure-to-Pay processes, supplier management, and cross-functional business operations.
• ERP experience is required; knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 is a strong asset.
• Experience in continuous improvement, process documentation, or ERP implementation projects is an asset.
• College diploma or university degree in Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, or a related field.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and process improvement skills.
• Autonomous, proactive, and collaborative, with the ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority.
• Bilingual French-English required.
Working Conditions & Benefits
• Project bonus, paid upon achievement of key implementation milestones.
• Comprehensive group insurance, 90% employer-paid.
• Retirement plan with employer contributions of up to 6%.
• Flexible schedule, primarily on-site with occasional remote work.
• Permanent position offering career development opportunities beyond the D365 implementation.

title: Restaurant Manager
description:
Sous l’autorité du directeur général, le gérant de service coordonne et supervise les activités du restaurant. Il agit à titre de support pour l’équipe du service.

Principales tâches:
○ Assurer la gestion efficace et efficiente de la prise de réservation
○ Assurer le maintien de la satisfaction des employés de son département
○ S’assurer de la rencontre des objectifs financiers; en collaboration avec la direction
générale.
○ S’assurer du bon déroulement général des opérations selon les standards de qualité
et d’expérience client.
○ Faire le suivi et les inventaires des fournitures des salles à manger;
○ Superviser et coordonner les activités de la salle à manger;
○ Observer et faire appliquer tous les règlements et politiques du restaurant. S’il y a
lieu, proposer des changements ou ajouts aux politiques afin de les améliorer et de
les adapter;
○ Être responsable de la sélection des employés de service, en collaboration avec le
directeur général
○ Déléguer et superviser la formation des nouveaux employés à l’aide du plan de
formation du restaurant;
○ S’assurer de la bonne tenue des dossiers des employés, tel que les avis
disciplinaires; en collaboration avec la direction générale.
○ Être le canal de communication entre les employés de services et la direction;
○ Inspecter la salle à manger, les aires de service et l’équipement et veiller à la
maintenance;
○ Effectuer toute autre tâche connexe

Avantages:
Horaire : Les horaires sont en alternance jour / soir permettant ainsi une variété dans les tâches et le rythme de travail. Pour favoriser un meilleur équilibre de vie, chaque membre de l’équipe bénéficie d’un week-end complet (samedi et dimanche) toutes les deux semaines.

Gratuités :
Repas gratuit
Canettes de bières gratuites

Bonus annuel :
Selon les objectifs fixés par l’entreprise concernant les coûts de salaire et les ventes, il y aura un bonus au rendement déterminé par le nombre d’heures travaillées.

title: Crane Operator (Day Shift)
description:
Job Description

The Crane Operator is responsible for hoisting, lifting, moving heavy loads, maintaining the overhead cranes, and also assisting other crane operators as necessary while complying to the company’s health and safety standards.

• Complete daily pre-use inspections prior to using a crane and other material handling equipment.

• Use WOFU and RFTM system to manage requisitions in the system.

• Operate forklift and crane including tandem crane to perform following duties as and when required:

• Unload coils, completing coil sheet, moving coils into roll forming area.

• Load coil on the upender/mandrel and scan the coils in the system for production.

• Move the partial strapped coils to the coil rack.

• Strap coils at the end of the shift.

• Sort/unload warehouse conveyor.

• Shunt trailers as required.

• Conduct general area clean up.

Practice good housekeeping, including 5S requirements, and time management in the performance of daily duties.
Comply with all legislated and Company’ Health, Safety, Environmental, Quality and Lean policies, procedures and programs.
Perform all other duties as assigned.

Company Description

Canam, an employer that makes you want to stay

Since 1960, Canam has been an employer with a strong, unifying and family-oriented culture, rallying its 5,100 employees. Established in Canada, the United States, Romania, India and the Philippines, our company continues to grow thanks to the innovation and know-how of each and every one of our employees. In fact, in order to build structures that are known and recognized for their quality throughout North America, you need to feel that you have what it takes to succeed in these major projects. Proud of our accomplishments, we are here to stay, and it is with you that we want to do so.

Qualifications

• Minimum 1-2 years experience operating heavy industrial equipment with proven ability to work safely and effectively in a fast-paced manufacturing setting.

• Ability to operate an overhead crane (Tandem Crane Operation) and forklift.

• Ability to read and interpret job specific technical documentation, precision measurement tools (e.g. tape measure, calipers) and possess basic English to complete necessary paperwork.

• Physical ability to routinely lift up to 50 lbs, continuously flip/stack materials, and rig loads for movement with a crane.

• Ability to interact with drivers delivering raw materials or picking up loads for shipment.;

• Must be willing to work independently and within a team, flexible shifts, accept shift transitions if required, and cover weekday and weekend overtime/absenteeism as needed.

• Shunting experience is required.

Additional Information

Unionized Role

Pay rate: $30.18 per hour

Day Shift: 6:00am to 2:30pm

*Overtime available during the week and weekends

title: Microsoft Fabric Consultant
description:
Our client is embarking on a strategic data modernization initiative and is seeking a senior Microsoft Fabric consultant to help establish a modern enterprise data platform. This is a greenfield opportunity to design and implement the foundation that will centralize data from numerous internal and external sources, creating a scalable, reliable source of truth for the organization.

Working closely with technical and business stakeholders, you will lead the discovery, architecture, and implementation of a Microsoft Fabric solution capable of ingesting, transforming, and organizing large volumes of structured and semi-structured data.

## What You'll Be Doing

• Lead the design and implementation of a Microsoft Fabric data platform.

• Conduct discovery sessions with internal stakeholders to understand current data sources, architecture, and future reporting requirements.

• Design scalable ingestion pipelines for data from approximately 30 external partners and internal systems.

• Build processes to ingest, validate, and transform large XML datasets into structured, analytics-ready formats.

• Develop robust ETL/ELT pipelines using Microsoft Fabric Data Factory, Lakehouse, and related Fabric services.

• Design and implement a modern data model that consolidates information from multiple systems into a single source of truth.

• Integrate data from SQL Server-based data warehouses, third-party vendors, and additional external data sources.

• Create reliable processes for handling inconsistent or imperfect source data while maintaining data quality and integrity.

• Collaborate with business and technical teams to support future reporting, commission, and analytics initiatives.

• Provide recommendations on Microsoft Fabric architecture, governance, security, and best practices.

## Required Experience

• Extensive experience implementing Microsoft Fabric in enterprise environments.

• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse, Data Factory, OneLake, notebooks, pipelines, and semantic models.

• Experience designing modern cloud-based data platforms and enterprise data warehouses.

• Strong ETL/ELT development experience moving data from multiple heterogeneous sources.

• Experience ingesting and transforming large XML datasets into relational or analytical models.

• Advanced SQL skills and experience working with SQL Server.

• Experience designing scalable data models and establishing a single source of truth across multiple business systems.

• Strong understanding of data architecture, data governance, and integration best practices.

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to lead technical discovery sessions and advise stakeholders.

## Nice to Have

• Experience within financial services, insurance, or wealth management.

• Experience integrating data from third-party APIs, legacy systems, or vendor file exchanges.

• Knowledge of Canadian insurance industry data standards or ACORD/CLHIA standards.

• Experience handling high-volume file processing and semi-structured data.

• Familiarity with Microsoft Azure data services.

title: Millwright (433A) – Afternoon Shift
description:
Job Description

The Millwright (433A) will maintain, troubleshoot, repair and optimize plant facilities, machinery, overhead/wall cranes and equipment. The Millwright will play a critical role in minimizing downtime, maintaining high safety standards, and driving continuous improvement through preventative, predictive, and corrective maintenance.

• Perform preventative, predictive, and corrective maintenance on industrial machinery and overhead and wall cranes

• Rapidly troubleshoot and repair equipment breakdowns (e.g., CNC punching/shearing lines, material transport systems, overhead/wall cranes, band saws, welding systems, and roll forming lines).

• Assemble, align, and install new machinery and mechanical components, including conveyors, bearings, gearboxes, motors, shafts, etc.

• Diagnose hydraulic, pneumatic, and fluid power system issues using technical schematics.

• Champion a safe working environment by strict adherence to lock-out/tag-out (LOTO) protocols, working-at-heights standards, and all health, safety, and environmental regulations.

• Maintain clean and organized work areas following 5S lean manufacturing principles.

• Conduct root-cause analysis on recurring mechanical issues to develop and implement long-term solutions.

• Accurate tracking of work orders, maintenance logs, and support spare parts inventory using our internal database.

• Collaborate with supervisors and production teams on special projects and facility improvements as assigned.

• Other duties as assigned

Company Description

Canam, an employer that makes you want to stay

Since 1960, Canam has been an employer with a strong, unifying and family-oriented culture, rallying its 5,100 employees. Established in Canada, the United States, Romania, India and the Philippines, our company continues to grow thanks to the innovation and know-how of each and every one of our employees. In fact, in order to build structures that are known and recognized for their quality throughout North America, you need to feel that you have what it takes to succeed in these major projects. Proud of our accomplishments, we are here to stay, and it is with you that we want to do so.

Qualifications

• Active 433A Industrial Mechanic Millwright License is required.

• Overhead crane technician experience preferred.

• Ability to read and interpret mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic schematics.

• Proficiency in MIG and ARC welding.

• Hands-on experience operating shop machine tools (lathe, milling machine, grinder, and standard hand/power tools).

• Working knowledge of Lock-Out/Tag-Out (LOTO) procedures and Working at Heights/ Scissor & Boom lifts.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills.

• Basic proficiency with computer systems (e.g., Maintenance Management systems /work order software, Google Workspace).

• Prior experience in a Lean Manufacturing or continuous improvement environment.

• Strong problem-solving mindset with demonstrated root-cause analysis skills.

Additional Information

Unionized Role

Pay rate: $42.61 per hour

Afternoon Shift: 4:00pm to 12:30am

*Overtime available during the week and weekends

title: Controller
description:
Our client, a well-established and respected construction company, is seeking an experienced Accounting Manager / Controller to oversee the day-to-day accounting and financial operations of the organization.

This is a hands-on leadership position suited to an accounting professional who enjoys taking ownership of the full accounting cycle while overseeing a small accounting/administrative team. The role will have responsibility for cash flow, financial reporting, payroll, AP/AR, government remittances, reconciliations, and accounting related to the company's property and tenant portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

## Financial Reporting & Accounting

• Prepare monthly and interim financial statements and management reporting.

• Lead the month-end close process, including monthly journal entries, reconciliations, and supporting schedules.

• Perform and review bank and general ledger account reconciliations.

• Prepare regular bank status and cash position reports.

• Manage cash flow and monitor short-term funding requirements.

• Prepare and coordinate federal and provincial corporate tax installments.

• Ensure accurate and timely HST/GST reporting and remittances.

## Accounts Receivable & Accounts Payable

• Manage accounts receivable, collections, and cash application.

• Oversee the accounts payable function and ensure invoices and payments are processed accurately and on time.

• Coordinate rush and priority cheque requirements.

• Monitor outstanding receivables and payables and proactively address issues.

## Payroll & Benefits

• Manage management/office payroll and oversee payroll administration for field employees.

• Ensure payroll information is accurate and processed within established deadlines.

• Coordinate employee benefit remittances.

• Manage WSIB claims, reporting, and clearance certificates.

## Property & Tenant Accounting

• Prepare monthly tenant billings.

• Track lease payments and TMI (taxes, maintenance, and insurance) recoveries.

• Monitor tenant accounts, outstanding balances, and related reconciliations.

• Maintain accurate accounting records relating to the company's properties and tenants.

## Team & Office Oversight

• Supervise the day-to-day activities of the accounting function.

• Review work completed by accounting staff and ensure appropriate internal controls are maintained.

• Establish priorities and ensure monthly accounting deadlines are consistently met.

• Work closely with ownership/senior management and provide timely financial information to support business decisions.

Qualifications

• 5+ years of progressive accounting experience, ideally within construction, property management, real estate, development, or a related industry.

• Strong hands-on experience with the full accounting cycle.

• Demonstrated experience with cash flow management, month-end reporting, AP, AR, payroll, bank reconciliations, and government remittances.

• Previous experience supervising or overseeing accounting staff.

• Knowledge of HST/GST, WSIB, payroll and corporate tax installment requirements.

• Strong Excel skills and experience working with accounting/ERP systems.

• CPA designation or accounting degree/diploma is an asset, but equivalent hands-on experience will be considered.

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities.

• A practical, hands-on approach with strong communication and problem-solving skills.

title: Cost Accountant
description:
We are looking for a Cost Accountant to join a manufacturing operation in Waterloo, Ontario and provide reliable financial insight that supports sound production and purchasing decisions. This position focuses on maintaining accurate product costing, reviewing operational variances, and delivering timely reporting that helps leaders understand plant performance. The successful candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams to strengthen cost controls, improve data accuracy, and contribute to budgeting and ongoing efficiency initiatives.

Responsibilities:
• Maintain standard cost information by reviewing historical data, validating assumptions, and updating costing records to reflect current operating conditions.
• Refresh raw material cost standards on a regular monthly cycle using forecast information supplied by the purchasing team.
• Verify that production recipes and process specifications reflect accurate run rates and labour assumptions for costing purposes.
• Investigate purchasing and material usage variances to identify discrepancies and keep bills of material and standard costs aligned with actual operations.
• Prepare cost models for new items, product changes, and initiatives aimed at reducing manufacturing spend.
• Collaborate with Purchasing, Research and Development, and Manufacturing to support cost approvals, track labour-related variances, and assess financial results after product launches.
• Produce recurring operational finance reports covering areas such as purchase price variance, labour performance, yield, inventory movements, production volumes, and overhead spending.
• Reconcile income statement activity by reviewing variance-related transactions and correcting inconsistencies where required.
• Analyze plant expenses and prepare journal entries related to labour, utilities, and inventory account reconciliations.
• Assist with the annual budgeting process and support cost-reduction efforts in partnership with operational finance leadership.

• At least 3 years of cost accounting experience within a manufacturing environment.

• Previous exposure to food manufacturing considered an asset.

• Hands-on experience with ERP platforms and cost accounting systems.

• Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Word.

• Solid analytical and problem-solving abilities with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.

• Effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines.

• Flexibility to work additional hours during month-end close periods when needed.

title: Controller
description:
Our client is a growing Canadian organization operating in a project-based environment and is seeking a Controller to join its leadership team. Reporting directly to the CFO, the Controller will lead the accounting function, oversee financial reporting, strengthen internal controls, and provide strategic financial support to the business. This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on finance leader who enjoys balancing day-to-day operations with process improvement and business partnering in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

## Key Responsibilities

• Lead accounting operations, including AP, AR, job costing, and general ledger activities.

• Manage month-end and year-end close, financial reporting, and account reconciliations.

• Ensure accurate financial reporting and maintain strong internal controls.

• Support budgeting, forecasting, cash flow management, and financial analysis.

• Partner with operational leaders to provide project performance reporting and business insights.

• Coordinate external audits, banking relationships, and regulatory compliance.

• Drive process improvements, system enhancements, and scalability initiatives.

• Mentor and develop the accounting team.

## Why Apply?

• Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits.

• Direct exposure to executive leadership and strategic initiatives.

• Significant opportunity for growth and advancement.

• Collaborative, entrepreneurial culture with an expanding organization.

• Opportunity to make a meaningful impact during an exciting period of growth.

## Qualifications

• CPA designation, CPA candidate nearing completion, or equivalent progressive accounting experience.

• 5+ years of accounting experience, including leadership or supervisory responsibilities.

• Strong knowledge of financial reporting, internal controls, and full-cycle accounting.

• Advanced Excel and ERP system experience.

• Excellent analytical, communication, and leadership skills.

• Experience in construction, infrastructure, transportation, industrial services, or other project-based industries is preferred.

• Job costing and project accounting experience is considered a strong asset.

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
## About the Opportunity

Robert Half Canada has partnered with an organization in the transportation, haulage, and logistics industry to hire a Payroll Administrator. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented payroll professional with experience managing payroll processes in a deadline-driven environment. The successful candidate will support accurate and timely payroll administration while maintaining compliance with company policies and applicable legislation.

## Key Responsibilities

• Process payroll accurately and on schedule for hourly, salaried, and, where applicable, unionized employees

• Maintain employee payroll records, including new hires, terminations, rate changes, deductions, and benefits updates

• Review and verify timesheets, attendance records, and payroll-related data for accuracy and completeness

• Administer statutory deductions, remittances, and year-end payroll reporting, including T4s and related documentation

• Respond to employee payroll inquiries in a professional and timely manner

• Reconcile payroll accounts and assist with month-end reporting and related journal entries

• Support payroll audits and maintain payroll documentation in an organized and confidential manner

• Coordinate with Human Resources, Accounting, and operational teams to ensure accurate payroll processing

• Monitor compliance with applicable employment standards, payroll legislation, and internal controls

• Identify opportunities to improve payroll procedures and reporting processes

• Postsecondary education in accounting, payroll, business administration, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

• Previous experience in a payroll administration or payroll processing role

• Strong knowledge of Canadian payroll practices, statutory deductions, and relevant legislation

• PCP designation or progress toward certification is considered an asset

• Proficiency with payroll systems, Microsoft Excel, and related office software

• Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and organizational skills

• Ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and professionalism

• Strong communication and problem-solving abilities

• Ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment

## Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in the transportation, logistics, or haulage industry

• Familiarity with payroll for hourly workforces, shift-based schedules, or union environments

• Experience supporting payroll reconciliations and year-end reporting

title: Project Finance Manager
description:
Founded in 2001, Fed Finance specializes in temporary and permanent recruitment for accounting and finance positions. Our consultants are all experts and speak your language. We are committed to supporting you throughout your job search and at every stage of your career.

Hello, I'm Bianka, Senior Team Leader at Fed Finance, a recruitment firm specializing in accounting, finance, and payroll. I handle both temporary and permanent recruitment in the Greater Montreal area.

Mission
• Manage project procurement activities and support Project Managers with planning, budget tracking, cost control, and client invoicing.
• Oversee the financial management of complex projects involving significant material procurement and Bill of Materials (BOM) management.
• Monitor purchase requisitions, supplier quotations, purchase orders, material receipts, vendor invoices, and backorders in collaboration with the procurement team.
• Analyze financial commitments related to material purchases and assess their impact on project budgets, forecasts, schedules, and profitability.
• Create, review, and integrate purchase orders into project management systems while ensuring the accuracy and integrity of financial data.
• Track variances between budgeted costs, committed costs, actual costs, and planned BOM quantities.
• Prepare financial analyses on price fluctuations, quantity variances, material consumption, and project cost risks.
• Establish and maintain budget control checkpoints and required financial documentation.
• Review and consolidate project progress reports against budgets and ongoing commitments.
• Prepare variance analyses, identify financial risks, and recommend mitigation strategies.
• Support budget revisions and ensure updates are accurately reflected in project management tools.
• Coordinate month-end activities related to cost forecasting, revenue recognition, and work-in-progress reporting.
• Analyze work-in-progress and prepare client invoices in accordance with contract terms, including time & materials, capped time & materials, and fixed-price projects.
• Ensure compliance with internal policies, financial controls, and company accounting standards.
• Monitor accounts receivable with Project Managers and follow up on supplier invoice payments.
• Act as a senior financial partner to Project Managers by providing clear insights into project costs, commitments, and profitability.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of project financial controls, reporting tools, KPIs, and processes.

Your profile
• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
• 10+ years of experience in a similar project management or project financial management role.

Technical Skills

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Project is considered an asset.
• Knowledge of the transportation industry or technical transportation projects is considered an asset.
• Strong verbal and written communication skills in both English and French.
• Ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders, including French-speaking and English-speaking clients.
• Capable of building strong client relationships, understanding business requirements, facilitating meetings, and communicating effectively in both official languages.

title: Licensed Diesel Truck Technician/Mechanic I
description:
Location: 17303 114 Ave NW Edmonton, AB T5S 2R9

Shift Premium: 2nd Shift ($3) 3rd Shift ($4) Weekend ($3)

Pay: $44-48

Shift: Monday-Friday 3:15pm-11:45pm

## Position Summary:

EXPERIENCED, LICENSED AND LOOKING FOR A COMPANY THAT RECOGNIZES YOUR VALUE? You are looking at the right company in Penske!

We have industry leading trucks, technology, tools, and experts in the vehicle maintenance industry committed to helping you develop your career with OEM training. If you are Dynamic, Motivated and Ready to live a unique opportunity, WE WANT YOU!

A Penske Technician I will diagnose, overhaul, adjust, and repair all series of motor truck and trailer equipment. This position demands a specialist in the field that will perform duties with little or no supervision and in a timely and efficient manner. Other exciting projects and tasks may be assigned by supervisor.

## We Offer You:

• Modern and clean work environment

• Industry leading technology and tools

• Competitive salary

• Attractive shift premiums

• New equipment and technology from variety of suppliers/dealerships

• RRSP program with company match

• Affordable health & dental benefit package

• Free uniforms and laundry service

• Tool and boots allowance

• Vacation time + 11 paid statutory holidays + paid sick days

• Tuition reimbursement

• Employee Assistance Program

• Comprehensive technical and professional training

• Opportunity for advancement throughout the company

• Partner’s discounts

## Major Responsibilities:

• Perform all levels of preventive maintenance services

• Identify warrantable repairs and document on repair order

• Maintain work area appearance and safety

• Road test vehicles when necessary to diagnose malfunctions or to ensure that they are working properly.

• Perform duties with little or no supervision and in a timely and efficient manner

• Use hand tools such as screwdrivers, pliers, wrenches, pressure gauges, and precision instruments, as well as power tools such as pneumatic wrenches, welding equipment, and jacks and hoists.

• Inspect brake systems, steering mechanisms, wheel bearings, and other important parts to ensure that they are in proper operating condition.

• Perform routine maintenance such as changing oil, checking batteries, and lubricating equipment and machinery.

• Adjust and replace brake, tighten bolts and screws, and reassemble equipment.

• Raise trucks, buses, and heavy parts or equipment using hydraulic jacks or hoists.

• Inspect, test, and listen to defective equipment to diagnose malfunctions, using test instruments such as handheld computers, motor analyzers, chassis charts, and pressure gauges.

• Examine and adjust protective guards, loose bolts, and specified safety devices.

• Inspect and verify dimensions and clearances of parts to ensure conformance to factory specifications.

• Specialize in repairing and troubleshooting of major components such as engine, transmissions and differentials, to include replacing complete assemblies, turbochargers, fuel system components etc.

• Other projects and tasks as assigned by supervisor

## Qualifications:

• 5+ years practical experience with tractor trailer maintenance required

• Must possess respective Provincial License such as Red Seal/310T

• Must maintain membership/registration with respective Government Agencies

• Current driver's license class D or class 3 with air brake certification required or ability to obtain it within 6 months of being hired

• Proficiency in the use of all tools of trade (including welding equipment, diagnostic equipment, hand and power tools) required

• Basic computer skills required

• Ability to work in non-climate controlled conditions required

• Specialized training and experience in the diagnosis/troubleshooting of major components (engines, transmissions, differentials), OEM training courses preferred

• Regular, predictable, full attendance is an essential function of the job

• Willingness to travel as necessary within the district (customers yards, close geographical area and training sites), work the required schedule, work at the specific location required, complete Penske employment application, submit to employment reference checks.

## Physical Requirements:

• The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an associate to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

-The associate must regularly lift and /or move up to 12kg, frequently lift and/or move up to 23kg and occasionally lift and/or move up to 45kg.

-Specific vision abilities required by this job include Close vision, Distance vision, Peripheral vision, Depth perception and Ability to adjust focus.

-While performing the duties of this Job, the associate is regularly required to stand; walk; sit and talk or hear. The associate is frequently required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel and reach with hands and arms.

title: Finance Manager
description:
Gestionnaire finances
Présentation du poste
L’un de nos clients est à la recherche d’un gestionnaire finances pour se joindre à son équipe à Montréal. Relevant de la direction des finances, la personne sera responsable du suivi financier d’un portefeuille d’entreprises, de la supervision des activités comptables et financières ainsi que du soutien aux initiatives stratégiques et opérationnelles. Ce rôle offre une combinaison de responsabilités en analyse financière, en gestion de la performance, en reporting, en intégration d’acquisitions et en encadrement d’équipe.

Poste : Gestionnaire finances
Industrie : Services Technologies
Localisation : St-Laurent – mode présentiel
Salaire : 125-135k + avantages (assurances, bonus)

Responsabilités
• Assurer le suivi de la performance financière d’un portefeuille d’entreprises et recommander des actions permettant d’atteindre les objectifs financiers.

• Élaborer et maintenir les prévisions financières mensuelles, trimestrielles et annuelles, tout en assurant le suivi des indicateurs de performance clés.

• Préparer et présenter des revues d’affaires périodiques mettant en lumière les résultats financiers, les plans correctifs et les initiatives de croissance.

• Analyser les risques financiers et la rentabilité des entreprises sous sa responsabilité afin de soutenir la prise de décision.

• Veiller à la santé financière des entités du portefeuille et assurer un niveau adéquat de liquidités.

• Participer activement aux projets d’acquisition et de cession d’entreprises.

• Agir à titre de référence pour l’ensemble des questions financières liées aux sociétés du portefeuille.

• Réviser les activités comptables, fiscales et réglementaires afin d’assurer leur conformité.

• Mettre en place et maintenir des contrôles internes efficaces ainsi que des processus conformes aux exigences corporatives.

• Coordonner les audits annuels et fournir la documentation requise aux auditeurs externes.

• Assurer le respect des obligations réglementaires et des échéanciers de production des rapports financiers.

• Identifier et mettre en œuvre des améliorations visant à accroître l’efficacité des processus de reporting financier.

• Superviser les membres des équipes comptables et financières, incluant les fonctions de comptabilité, d’analyse financière, de comptes recevables et de comptes payables.

• Contribuer au développement et à la formation des employés afin de favoriser la performance et l’amélioration continue.

• Participer à l’implantation et à l’optimisation des systèmes financiers utilisés par les différentes entités.

• Évaluer les processus existants, identifier les opportunités d’automatisation et soutenir la mise en œuvre de solutions d’amélioration.

• Assurer l’intégrité des données financières lors des initiatives de transformation des systèmes.

Exigences
• Baccalauréat en comptabilité, finance, économie ou dans une discipline connexe; titre CPA considéré comme un atout.

• Minimum de cinq années d’expérience dans un rôle similaire, incluant au moins deux années d’expérience en gestion d’équipe.

• Maîtrise de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.

• Solide compréhension des processus financiers, des contrôles internes et de la gestion des risques.

• Excellentes capacités d’analyse, de communication, d’organisation et de gestion des priorités.

• Maîtrise avancée d’Excel; expérience avec un ERP financier considérée comme un atout.

title: Accounting Manager
description:
Accounting Manager

Are you a CPA (or CPA-track) professional who thrives in a fast-paced sales and service environment and enjoys owning the financial processes that keep a business running efficiently?

Our client is seeking a hands-on accounting leader to take ownership of financial reporting, cash management, reconciliations, and operational accounting. This highly visible role will partner closely with Sales, Service, Collections, Operations, and senior leadership to ensure strong financial controls, optimize working capital, and support business growth.

What You'll Own

• Lead the full month-end and year-end close process, ensuring accurate financial reporting, account reconciliations, accruals, foreign exchange transactions, and general ledger integrity.

• Own balance sheet reconciliations, intercompany accounting, and multi-entity financial activities, proactively identifying and resolving discrepancies.

• Manage daily treasury and cash management functions, including cash positioning, cash flow forecasting, borrowing requirements, liquidity management, bank relationships, and foreign currency exposure.

• Monitor working capital performance, supporting collections, receivables management, cash conversion initiatives, and process improvements across the business.

• Prepare and analyze financial statements, management reporting packages, cash flow reporting, profitability analysis, and operational performance metrics.

• Partner closely with Sales and Service leadership to evaluate business performance, customer profitability, revenue trends, and operational initiatives.

• Support revenue recognition, deferred revenue accounting, warranty reserves, and transactional review within a high-volume commercial environment.

• Drive continuous improvement in accounting processes, internal controls, reconciliations, reporting accuracy, and financial systems.

• Coordinate audit, tax, banking, compliance, and regulatory reporting requirements while maintaining strong governance and financial controls.

• Mentor and develop team members while fostering a collaborative, accountable, and customer-focused finance culture.

What We're Looking For

• Bachelor's Degree in Accounting or Finance.

• CPA designation preferred (or actively pursuing designation).

• 6+ years of progressive accounting experience within a sales, service, distribution, equipment, industrial, or multi-location organization.

• Strong experience with cash management, treasury activities, reconciliations, financial reporting, and month-end close.

• Proven ability to manage complex balance sheet accounts, intercompany transactions, and working capital initiatives.

• Experience partnering with commercial teams, including Sales, Customer Service, Operations, or Collections.

• Advanced Excel skills and experience with ERP and financial reporting systems.

• Strong analytical, communication, and relationship-building skills with the ability to influence stakeholders across the organization.

Why This Role Stands Out

This is more than a traditional accounting role. It's an opportunity to become a key finance partner within a dynamic sales and service organization where you'll have direct exposure to cash flow management, commercial operations, and executive decision-making. You'll play a critical role in driving financial discipline, improving working capital, strengthening controls, and supporting the continued growth of the business.

title: Controller
description:
Our client, a growing North American subsidiary of a global organization, is seeking an experienced Controller to lead its accounting and finance function. Reporting to executive leadership, the Controller will oversee financial reporting, compliance, treasury, budgeting, internal controls, and team leadership while serving as a key liaison with the organization's international finance teams.

This is a hands-on leadership position that combines strategic oversight with day-to-day involvement in complex accounting and financial matters. The successful candidate will play a key role in strengthening processes, developing team capabilities, and supporting ongoing business growth.

## Key Responsibilities

Financial Leadership & Reporting

• Lead month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close processes.

• Oversee preparation and review of financial statements, management reporting, and balance sheet reconciliations.

• Develop budgets, forecasts, and financial analysis to support business decisions.

• Ensure timely and accurate reporting to executive leadership and global finance stakeholders.

Team Leadership

• Establish strong internal controls, review procedures, and accountability measures.

• Standardize processes and implement cross-training initiatives to improve operational effectiveness.

• Provide guidance on complex accounting and operational issues.

Compliance, Tax & Audit

• Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and corporate policies.

Treasury & Working Capital

• Manage cash flow, banking relationships, and treasury activities.

• Monitor working capital requirements and provide visibility into liquidity and financial performance.

• Support foreign currency and intercompany transaction management.

Systems & Process Improvement

• Lead finance process improvement initiatives.

• Participate in ERP evaluation, implementation, and optimization projects.

• Drive efficiencies through automation, controls, and best practices.

• CPA designation strongly preferred.

• 7+ years of progressive accounting experience, including leadership experience as a Controller, Assistant Controller, Accounting Manager, or similar role.

• Experience within manufacturing, distribution, trading, import/export, or multinational environments is highly preferred.

• Strong background in financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, treasury, tax, and internal controls.

• Experience working with intercompany transactions, foreign currency accounting, and international reporting structures.

• Demonstrated ERP experience and advanced Excel skills.

• Professional fluency in English, Mandarin, and Cantonese is required.

• Strong leadership, communication, and relationship-management skills.

title: Systems Analyst
description:
We’re looking for a Systems Analyst to support an organization as it maintains and improves its current CRM environment while beginning the assessment and selection of its future platform. This 6-month contract will work full-time on-site in Edmonton.

This is a hands-on role combining systems support, data integration and analysis with current-state documentation and requirements gathering. The successful candidate will spend approximately 50% of their time supporting the existing technology environment and 50% helping the organization document processes, identify gaps and define future system requirements.

## What You’ll Be Doing

• Support and maintain the organization’s existing CRM environment, currently built on Maximizer CRM

• Troubleshoot system, data and reporting issues and help improve overall data quality

• Work with integrations between the CRM and other business platforms

• Transform incoming data, including flat-file feeds, into formats that can be consumed by the CRM

• Work with APIs, SQL-based data and cloud-hosted systems

• Support the creation and maintenance of custom CRM fields, workflows and functionality

• Assist with data exports, cleanup and reconciliation

• Document the organization’s current-state systems, processes and integrations

• Identify system limitations, process gaps and opportunities for improvement

• Gather business and technical requirements as the organization evaluates future CRM and association management platforms

• Support early-stage needs analysis and eventual product selection

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including a Data Analyst supporting reporting and Power BI initiatives

## What We’re Looking For

• A few years of experience working as a Systems Analyst, Business Systems Analyst, Application Analyst, CRM Analyst or similar

• Experience supporting a relational database-driven CRM or business application

• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure

• Experience working with APIs, system integrations and data transformation

• Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases

• Experience documenting systems, processes, requirements and current-state environments

• Strong troubleshooting skills and comfort working with legacy systems and custom solutions

• Ability to translate business requirements into practical system improvements

## Nice to Have

• Experience with Maximizer CRM — not required

• Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central

• Experience with association management systems, membership platforms or benefits administration environments

• Power BI exposure

The organization currently operates several legacy and highly customized solutions and is approaching the point where its existing CRM can no longer effectively support all of its business requirements. This individual will help keep the current environment running while laying the groundwork for the organization’s next-generation platform.

title: Account Lead E-Commerce

description:
Poste : responsable de comptes, commerce en ligne
Lieu de travail : LaSalle, QC (en personne)

Aperçu

Nous recherchons un(e) responsable de comptes, commerce électronique dynamique et axé(e) sur les résultats pour diriger et développer des comptes en ligne clés aux États-Unis et au Canada. Ce poste, au sein du service des ventes et du développement des affaires, joue un rôle essentiel dans notre expansion numérique et la croissance de nos revenus. Le candidat idéal sera doté d’un esprit stratégique et de solides compétences analytiques, capable de gérer et d’entretenir des relations avec des partenaires du commerce électronique tout en menant des initiatives qui s’alignent sur nos objectifs d’affaires.

Relevant du directeur du commerce électronique, des TI et des opérations, vous serez chargé de superviser le rendement des ventes, de maximiser la rentabilité et d’améliorer la visibilité de la marque sur plusieurs plateformes en ligne. Ce poste exige une étroite collaboration avec des équipes interfonctionnelles, notamment celles des ventes, du marketing et de la chaîne d’approvisionnement.

Principales responsabilités :

- Gérer et analyser toutes les données relatives aux comptes, en tirant parti de l’analyse de données pour cerner les tendances et les comportements des consommateurs.
- Traduire ces informations en stratégies concrètes et en recommandations d’affaires.
- Établir et entretenir des partenariats solides avec les détaillants en ligne afin d’accroître l’engagement et de stimuler la croissance.
- Diriger des séances de planification stratégique visant à étendre notre présence sur les plateformes en ligne actuelles et potentielles.
- Identifier, démarcher et concrétiser de nouvelles occasions d’affaires en ligne afin d’élargir les sources de revenus à l’échelle nationale et internationale.
- Élaborer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies de croissance visant à accroître la part de marché et la visibilité de la marque.
- Harmoniser les processus de gestion des stocks et de prévision avec la demande des consommateurs afin d’assurer des niveaux de stocks optimaux.
- Collaborer avec les équipes internes sur les prévisions afin de soutenir la disponibilité des produits et les objectifs d’affaires.
- Travailler en partenariat avec les équipes des ventes, du marketing et de la chaîne d’approvisionnement pour élaborer et gérer les plans promotionnels et les budgets.
- Lancer et gérer des campagnes qui s’inscrivent dans le cadre d’initiatives d’affaires plus larges.
- Vérifier et optimiser régulièrement la présence en ligne, en veillant à la cohérence des prix, des descriptions de produits, des images et des messages de marque sur toutes les plateformes de vente au détail.
- Assurer une expérience utilisateur hors pair sur tous les points de contact du commerce en ligne.
- Favoriser une mise en œuvre harmonisée des stratégies de marque sur l’ensemble des canaux en ligne.
- Diriger les initiatives d’optimisation du rendement en collaboration avec l’ensemble des équipes du commerce en ligne et du numérique.
- Identifier et tirer parti des occasions telles que les promotions saisonnières, les lancements de produits et les offres groupées afin de générer des revenus supplémentaires.

Qualifications :

- 3 à 4 ans d’expérience en gestion de comptes de commerce en ligne, en gestion de catégories ou dans un domaine connexe
- Capacité avérée à gérer des projets complexes de manière autonome et en collaboration
- Solides compétences en matière de prévision, de planification et de gestion des stocks
- Expérience avérée dans l’élaboration et la mise en œuvre de stratégies promotionnelles sur les plateformes numériques
- Excellentes compétences en gestion de projet et en présentation
- Maîtrise de Microsoft Excel, Word et PowerPoint
- Solides compétences analytiques et capacité à transformer les données en actions stratégiques
- Excellentes aptitudes en communication et en établissement de relations
- Très motivé(e), proactif(ve) et axé(e) sur les résultats, avec un esprit stratégique et entrepreneurial
- Maîtrise du français (parlé et écrit)

Autre exigence linguistique : anglais
- Niveau de maîtrise requis : avancé
- Raisons de l’exigence linguistique : communication avec les clients, marketing et publicité, service à la clientèle
- Fréquence d’utilisation : constamment (pour presque toutes les tâches)

title: Sr. Financial Analyst
description:
We are looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to join a growing manufacturing organization in Toronto, Ontario. This role will play a central part in financial planning and analysis by delivering insights that support budgeting, forecasting, performance reporting, and strategic decision-making. The successful candidate will work closely with finance and operational leaders to strengthen visibility into business performance and help guide investment, project, and profitability decisions.

Responsibilities:

• Drive the monthly forecasting process across key financial areas such as sales, gross margin, operating costs, and cash flow to support accurate planning.

• Contribute to the annual budgeting cycle by developing robust financial models and combining submissions from multiple business areas into a unified plan.

• Review monthly financial performance, investigate differences from plan, and prepare clear reporting materials for leadership review.

• Evaluate project and contract profitability by comparing budgets, forecasts, and actual results to highlight risks and opportunities.

• Create dashboards, reporting tools, and analysis that give operational teams timely visibility into financial and business performance.

• Monitor performance indicators related to productivity, margins, backlog, sales pipeline, working capital, and cash efficiency.

• Prepare financial content and presentation materials for board-level reporting on a monthly basis.

• Assist with financial modelling, analysis, and due diligence activities tied to acquisition opportunities and other strategic initiatives.

• Partner with project managers on job costing, change orders, margin leakage analysis, and revenue recognition.

• Improve financial processes, controls, and reporting automation.

Qualifications

• CPA designation or MBA is strongly preferred.

• 3 - 5+ years of experience in FP& A,

• Experience working with the 3 Financial Statements Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow is required.

• Experience in construction, engineering, or project-based industries is strongly preferred.

• Advanced Excel and financial modelling skills required, Power BI or similar BI tools an asset.

• Strong understanding of P& L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow, Working Capital, and project costing.

• Ability to establish close working relationships with key stakeholders.

• Knowledge of Adaptive and Viewpoint an asset.

• Ability to work under tight deadlines in a high-performance, PE-backed environment.

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to present findings to senior leadership.

description:
Contrôleur
Présentation du poste
Notre client est actuellement à la recherche d’un Contrôleur pour un poste à Québec. Relevant de la direction des finances en Amérique du Nord, la personne retenue assumera la responsabilité de la fonction finance et comptabilité pour deux entités aux activités axées sur les projets, la fabrication et le développement de produits. Elle agira comme principale ressource financière sur place et contribuera à l’amélioration continue des processus et des contrôles.

Poste : Contrôleur
Industrie : services industriels
Lieu : Ville de Québec
Salaire : 125-135k + avantages sociaux

Responsabilités
• Assurer les clôtures mensuelles, trimestrielles et annuelles ainsi que l’ensemble du cycle comptable.

• Préparer les rapports financiers périodiques, les dossiers de consolidation et les analyses destinées à la direction financière.

• Effectuer le suivi des rapprochements bancaires et des comptes du bilan et de l’état des résultats dans les délais requis.

• Gérer les transactions intersociétés et les opérations multidevises.

• Élaborer et maintenir les prévisions de trésorerie, les budgets et les analyses des écarts en collaboration avec la direction.

• Produire des suivis liés au fonds de roulement, aux flux de trésorerie et au rythme d’exploitation des activités.

• Prendre en charge la comptabilité de projets, incluant les coûts, les travaux en cours, la reconnaissance des revenus, la facturation et le suivi de la rentabilité.

• Collaborer avec les responsables des opérations et des projets afin d’assurer l’exactitude des coûts, des heures travaillées et des données de facturation.

• Superviser les activités de trésorerie, les paiements et la gestion courante des relations bancaires.

• Encadrer les processus de facturation, de recouvrement, de comptes clients et de comptes fournisseurs.

• Veiller à l’application des politiques internes liées aux dépenses et au codage des cartes de crédit.

• Superviser le traitement de la paie ainsi que les remises et déclarations gouvernementales requises.

• Participer à la préparation des déclarations fiscales corporatives avec les conseillers externes.

• Identifier, obtenir et administrer les programmes d’aide financière, crédits d’impôt et subventions applicables.

• Assurer la gestion comptable des stocks, des coûts de production, des écarts de fabrication et des immobilisations.

• Maintenir les registres d’actifs et les calendriers d’amortissement à jour.

• Structurer, uniformiser et optimiser les processus financiers dans le système de gestion intégré de l’entreprise.

• Utiliser les outils d’intelligence d’affaires disponibles afin de fournir des indicateurs de performance et des analyses pertinentes.

• Documenter les processus, les contrôles internes et les meilleures pratiques afin d’assurer la conformité aux standards du groupe.

• Agir comme personne-ressource auprès des auditeurs externes et des institutions financières.

• Diriger, encadrer et développer une équipe composée de trois employés.

• Communiquer efficacement avec les différentes parties prenantes en français et en anglais tout en travaillant de façon autonome.

Exigences
• Titre professionnel CPA obligatoire.

• Environ cinq ans d’expérience dans un rôle de contrôleur.

• Expérience significative en comptabilité de projets, idéalement dans un contexte de services par projets ou industriel.

• Connaissance de la comptabilité de fabrication, des stocks et de la consolidation de plusieurs entités.

• Expérience avec des systèmes ERP, dont Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (atout), ainsi qu’avec Power BI.

• Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit.

• Capacité démontrée à améliorer les processus et à moderniser les fonctions financières.

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
Nous recherchons un administrateur de la paie rigoureux pour se joindre à l'organisation de notre client. La personne retenue prendra en charge des activités de paie complètes pour des employés répartis dans plusieurs provinces canadiennes, tout en assurant la conformité aux obligations légales et aux politiques internes. Ce rôle convient à une personne organisée, autonome et axée sur l’exactitude, ayant le souci du détail et capable d’offrir un soutien fiable aux employés et aux gestionnaires. Une certaine flexibilité d’horaire peut être offerte durant les périodes moins occupées, selon les besoins et l’intérêt de la personne choisie.

Responsabilités:
• Assurer le traitement complet de la paie pour des employés dans plusieurs provinces canadiennes, en respectant les échéanciers établis et les exigences réglementaires applicables.
• Vérifier les données de paie, apporter les corrections nécessaires et administrer les retenues, ajustements et paiements particuliers avec précision.
• Effectuer les conciliations de paie et les contrôles requis afin de confirmer l’exactitude des montants versés et des informations au dossier.
• Produire les relevés d’emploi et tenir à jour les soldes de vacances, d’absences et d’autres banques de congés des employés.
• Préparer les remises gouvernementales ainsi que les autres versements liés à la paie, en veillant au respect des délais et des obligations légales.
• Générer les rapports de paie et maintenir une documentation complète, structurée et conforme pour fins de suivi et d’audit.
• Coordonner les activités de fin d’année de paie, y compris les rapprochements, les ajustements et l’émission des feuillets T4, RL-1 et autres déclarations requises.
• Réconcilier les factures mensuelles d’assurances collectives et assurer le suivi des cotisations aux régimes de retraite ou programmes connexes.
• Répondre aux questions des employés et des gestionnaires en matière de paie en offrant un service clair, rigoureux et orienté vers les solutions.

• Posséder au moins 3 ans d’expérience pertinente en paie, incluant la gestion complète du cycle de paie.
• Avoir traité la paie d’employés situés au Québec, en Ontario et dans d’autres provinces canadiennes.
• Démontrer une solide expérience des activités de fin d’année, notamment les conciliations et la production des feuillets T4 et RL-1.
• Bien maîtriser la législation canadienne en matière de paie, les remises gouvernementales et les obligations statutaires.

description:

La personne retenue jouera un rôle clé dans la préparation de dossiers financiers, la production de déclarations fiscales et le suivi des opérations liées aux placements. title: Accounting Director
description:
Nous sommes à la recherche d’un directeur de la comptabilité chevronné pour diriger les activités d’information financière d’une organisation bancaire située à Montréal. Dans ce rôle, vous superviserez l’exactitude et la production en temps opportun des rapports financiers internes et externes, soutiendrez la prise de décision de la haute direction grâce à des informations financières fiables et assurerez une collaboration étroite avec les auditeurs ainsi qu’avec les principales parties prenantes. Vous contribuerez également à renforcer les opérations financières en optimisant les processus, en supervisant les systèmes financiers et en dirigeant une équipe comptable hautement performante.

Responsabilités :
• Diriger le cycle complet de clôture financière mensuelle afin d’assurer des résultats exacts, cohérents et livrés dans les délais établis.
• Superviser la production des états financiers ainsi que la diffusion de l’information financière destinée à la direction, aux auditeurs, aux investisseurs et aux autres parties prenantes.
• Encadrer les audits internes et externes en coordonnant la préparation des documents requis, le suivi des demandes et la résolution des écarts relevés.
• Mettre en place une gouvernance rigoureuse des rapprochements de comptes pour renforcer les contrôles et la fiabilité des données financières.
• Soutenir la comptabilisation des charges, des contrats de location et des éléments liés à la trésorerie conformément aux normes applicables.
• Assurer la supervision des systèmes financiers afin de maintenir l’intégrité des processus, la qualité de l’information et l’efficacité opérationnelle.
• Contribuer aux initiatives d’amélioration continue de la fonction finance en revoyant les méthodes de travail et en optimisant les processus clés.
• Participer à l’intégration comptable et financière des acquisitions en veillant à l’harmonisation des pratiques et des contrôles.
• Mobiliser, encadrer et développer une équipe de professionnels de la finance en favorisant la performance, la collaboration et l’évolution des compétences.

• Minimum de 7 ans d’expérience progressive en comptabilité, en information financière ou dans un rôle de direction connexe.
• Expérience démontrée en production de rapports financiers annuels et en préparation d’états financiers.
• Solide compréhension des processus de clôture financière, des rapprochements et des contrôles internes.
• Expérience en gestion d’audits et en collaboration avec des parties prenantes internes et externes.
• Capacité reconnue à diriger une équipe et à faire évoluer les pratiques dans un environnement financier structuré.
• Maîtrise des systèmes financiers et aisance à améliorer les processus liés à la production d’information financière.
• Excellentes habiletés d’analyse, d’organisation et de communication en contexte de priorités multiples.

title: IT Support Intern
description:
Description du poste

Stage offert à l’automne ou à l’hiver.

## Ta vie de stagiaire chez Canam

Tu cherches à intégrer une équipe dont le travail a un impact significatif pour l’entreprise? Tu veux t’impliquer dans des projets d’envergure et évoluer dans une entreprise en pleine transformation numérique? Alors, viens faire ton stage chez Canam!

En tant que stagiaire en soutien informatique tu auras pour mandat d’assister l’équipe TI dans l’installation, la configuration et le déploiement des postes informatiques (incluant la gestion des données usagers) et des appareils mobiles via notre outil UEM. Tu joueras également un rôle clé dans le maintien rigoureux de l’inventaire, la réception des marchandises TI et le soutien direct aux utilisateurs pour l’ensemble de leurs équipements informatiques et technologiques.

Cela dit, c’est ton équipe qui te donnera le plus de satisfaction, car chez Canam, nous sommes un alliage solide de formations et d’opportunités de carrières!

## Les avantages Canam

Nous t’offrons des horaires flexibles, une rémunération à la hauteur de ton talent, des opportunités de carrière nombreuses et toutes sortes d’autres avantages selon le lieu où tu auras l’occasion de travailler. Toi aussi, tu profiteras de cette expérience à ne pas manquer, comme en témoignent nos ancien.ne.s stagiaires :

« Les gens sont très accueillants et disponibles pour aider avec les projets. Ils sont ouverts à collaborer avec les stagiaires et offrent un soutien formidable, ce qui contribue grandement à notre amélioration au quotidien. » Anne-Sophie M., Stagiaire aux approvisionnements

« C’est définitivement une expérience enrichissante pour laquelle je suis privilégié d’avoir été choisi. J’ai une réelle impression d’être utile à l’entreprise, même si j’ai encore une panoplie de choses à apprendre. C’est un énorme « boost » pour l’estime de soi. » Rémi L., stagiaire en gestion de projets

« Excellent accueil. Technologies modernes. Méthodologie agile bien appliquée. » Vincent B., stagiaire en développement logiciel

Qualifications

## Compétences et connaissances recherchées :

• Être en voie d’obtenir un DEC, AEC ou DEP en informatique

• Tu devras avoir des connaissances en/des :

• Systèmes d’exploitation tels que Windows (7 à 11), Linux et MacOS

• Administration des produits VMware

• Administration de Windows serveur (Active Directory, Microsoft NTFS, DFS, DNS et DHCP)

• Appareils mobiles tels que Android et iPhone

• Outils de la suite Google Workspace

• Réseautique et administration de produits tels que Cisco, Fortinet, etc. (notions)

Informations complémentaires

Canam, un employeur qui donne envie de rester

Depuis 1960, Canam se veut un employeur avec une culture forte, rassembleuse et familiale, ralliant près de 5 100 employé.e.s. Établie au Canada, aux États-Unis, en Roumanie, en Inde et aux Philippines, notre entreprise ne cesse de croître grâce à l’innovation et au savoir-faire de chacun.e. D’ailleurs, pour bâtir des structures connues et reconnues pour leur qualité à travers l’Amérique du Nord, tu dois sentir que tu as tout ce qu’il faut pour réussir ces projets d’envergure. Fiers de nos réalisations, nous sommes là pour rester, et c’est avec toi que nous voulons le faire.

Nous respectons l’équité en matière d’emploi.
